classes.intro: The Abronian ship was a small spacecraft used by the Abronians. Large numbers of them were stored aboard the moon that the Abronians had converted into a starship to save their species from a supernova.
The Academy trainer craft was a type of agile sublight spacecraft flown by Starfleet Academy cadets as flight training vessels, that were also utilized for competitive or demonstrative purposes.
An aeroshuttle was a runabout-sized spacecraft embedded in the saucer underside of , , and starships, and detached to Starfleet starbases in the 2370s and 2380s.

The Agena target vehicle (or ATV) was an unmanned spacecraft that was in service to NASA in the mid-1960s. This vehicle was used for developing and practicing orbital rendezvous between spacecraft in the Gemini Program. This was an essential step in the preparation up to the Apollo program. The first successful docking of an Agena test vehicle to a manned spacecraft occurred on March 16, 1966 during the Gemini 8 mission. On approach, the crew of Gemini 8 photographed the vehicle's profile as it orbited over Earth.
The Akira-class was a class of Federation starship that was in service with Starfleet by the early 2370s.

An Akritirian cargo vessel (also called a Akritirian freighter) was a type of freighter used by the Akritirians during the 24th century. The vessel was small enough in size to be towed into the shuttlebay of an starship.
The Akritirian patrol ship was a type of starship used by the Akritirians to enforce laws in their space.
The Aksani vessel was a type of starship utilized by the Aksani during the late 24th century.
An Al-Leyan transport was a type of transport utilized during the latter half of the 24th century.
The Alita class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the early 25th century.
The Ambassador-class starship was a type of heavy cruiser in service with Starfleet during the mid- to late-24th century. ()
The Andorian battle cruiser was a type of warship in service with the Andorian Imperial Guard during the mid-22nd century through the late 24th century.
The Andorian cruiser was a type of small cruiser and support ship that was in service with the Andorian Imperial Guard during the 22nd century.
An Andorian escape pod was a type of emergency vessel-escape vehicle used by the Andorian Imperial Guard in their vessels during the 22nd century, particularly in Andorian battle cruisers.
Andorian freighters were cargo vessels commonly used in the Andorian Empire during the 22nd century.
An Andorian ship was a type of transport operated by the Andorian Imperial Guard for the Andorian Empire in the mid-22nd century.
The Andorian shuttle was a small shuttlecraft operated by the Andorians in the mid-22nd century.

This Andorian starship was a type of armed starship operated by the Andorians during the 24th century. This class's body was based on the Andorian battle cruiser space frame but also included the tail fin similar to that found on the smaller Andorian cruiser.
An Andorian transport was a type of transport operating under an Andorian registry.
Angel's shuttle was a small warp-capable shuttle operated by the pirate .

The Angelou class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 31st and 32nd centuries. It featured a torus-shaped design that supported a rainforest ecosystem within a transparent exterior. ()
The Angosian escape pod was a type of escape pod used by Angosian police shuttles.
The Angosian police shuttle was a type of small police vessel utilized by the Angosians to transport prisoners. It had a cockpit designed for two operators and at least two additional compartments.
The Ankari vessel was a class of starship used by the Ankari in the late-24th century. Vessels of this type used a form of propulsion that was difficult for normal sensors to detect.
The Antares class cruiser was a type of starship operated by civilians, sometimes independently, in and around the United Earth colonies, throughout the , and by the Petarians.
The Antares-type was a small, multipurpose 23rd century Federation starship identified as a survey ship, transport, cargo, science-probe vessel, or ore freighter.
The Antares type escape pod was a type of emergency escape vehicle used on Federation freighters to evacuate a ship during an emergency.
The Antarian starship was a type of warp-capable starship utilized by the Antarians, who employed the class in the Delta Quadrant during the late 24th century.
An Antidean transport was a type of transport used by the Antideans.
The Apergosian shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft used by the Apergosians during the 2380s.
The Apollo-class was a class of Federation starship in operation during the 24th century.

The Apollo spacecraft was a type of 20th century Earth spacecraft used by the United States of America during the 1960s and 1970s. The Apollo spacecraft, which consisted of three primary components, was propelled into space by means of a rocket. In the Apollo program, it was responsible for successfully placing a man in orbit of Earth and the moon, as well as conducting several successful moon landings. After the last mission on Luna, the spacecraft was responsible for transporting astronauts to the space station Skylab.
The aqua-shuttle was a type of Federation shuttle stowed aboard the shuttlebay of vessels during the late 2260s.
The Aquarius class was a 24th and 25th century Federation starship class used as an auxiliary escort vessel, which was embedded within the aft section of starships.
The Arctic One type was a type of transport used by the Earth Sciences Institute during the 2150s. Their maximum speed was warp 1.4.
An Ardanan shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft used by the Ardanans prior to the mid-22nd century.
The Ares V was an American expendable rocket used by NASA in the early 21st century.
An Arkonian military vessel was a type of military vessel utilized by the Arkonian military during the mid-22nd century.
An Arkonian patrol ship was a type of patrol ship utilized by the Arkonian military. These one-manned vessels easily outclassed Earth Starfleet s.
The Armstrong-type was a type of starship used by Starfleet in the mid-23rd century. This type was unique for Starfleet in that some of its ships were painted brown.

The Arretan vessel was a type of ancient starship used by Arretan 6,000 centuries before 2268. With a size equivalent to the , this vessel was powered by an engine the size of a walnut. She, and her sister ships, were used for colonization and exploration. Their travels were documented in records, which were lost in the war which destroyed the species' and their homeworld. ()
The Assault-class was a type of starship utilized by the Hierarchy in the 24th century, equipped with advanced short and long range sensors, including micro-tunneling sensors.
An asteroid mining pod was a type of spacecraft used to mine asteroids for natural resources. Such pods were operated by the Automated Personnel Units created by the Pralor species.
An asteroid-runner was a type of 22nd century spacecraft that used an axis coil for navigation.
The Atlas-Agena was an American expendable rocket that was in service with NASA diring the mid-20th century.
The Atlec vessel was a Class 7 interplanetary vessel used by the Atlec government in the mid 24th century.

The Axanar cargo ship was a type of freighter used by the Axanar during the mid-22nd century. Crewed by as many as fifteen, a typical ship of this type was approximately ninety-two meters in length, and had a hull comprised of tritanium and disilicon polymers.
The Axanar warship was a type of warship used by the Axanar during the mid-22nd century.

The B'omar patrol ship was a type of small starship used by the B'omar Sovereignty to guard B'omar space. It was armed with directed energy weapons and torpedoes, and protected by shields. Tactically, it was inferior to a Federation Type 6 shuttlecraft.
The Ba'Neth ship was a type of starship utilized by the Ba'Neth, a xenophobic species in the Delta Quadrant, first discovered in 2376.
The Ba'ul fighter was a type of small, warp-capable attack fighter built by the Ba'ul. It was flown by a single pilot and mounted directed energy weaponry.

The Ba'ul sentry ship was a type of starship used by the Ba'ul to defend their homeworld of Kaminar. They were much larger than a Federation starship, and featured multiple weapons emplacements that extended outward when active.
A Bajoran cargo shuttle was a type of cargo shuttle used by the Bajorans.

Bajoran interceptors or Bajoran patrol ships, were a type of impulse ship often utilized as interceptors by the Bajoran Militia, that were lightly armed with two phaser emitters. The vessels also had towing facilities. (; ) It was generally believed by Commander Benjamin Sisko that a Starfleet runabout could handle a Bajoran patrol. ()

classes.cr: Could be operated by a single individual
classes.intro: A Bajoran lightship was a type of early Bajoran spacecraft, partially constructed of lumber, which utilized solar sail-powered spaceflight.
Bajoran raiders, or more specifically sub-impulse raiders, were antiquated, lightly-armed sub-impulse powered raiders used by the Bajorans during the mid-24th century.
A Bajoran transport was a type of warp-capable transport utilized by the Bajorans following the Occupation of Bajor.
The Bajoran vessel was a versatile type of spacecraft utilized by the Bajoran Militia as an assault vessel, scout ship, and transport during the late-24th century.
The Banean warship was a class of ship used by the Banea in the late-24th century.
Bardeezan merchant ships were freighters utilized by the Bardeezans during the 24th century.
A Barolian freighter was a type of freighter utilized by the Barolians for conducting trade during the mid-24th century.
The BBI-993 was a type of Earth starship that was utilized during the 22nd century. They were in use as early as 2137. ( okudagram)
"BC 011" was the ship classification given by Starfleet Operations to a mercenary vessel operated, for a time in 2369 and 2370, by Arctus Baran. ()
A Benkaran shuttle was a starship operated by the Benkarans in the Delta Quadrant.
The Benthan fighter ships were starships used by the Benthan Guard. They were equipped with phasers and tractor beams.

A Benzite ship was a type of starship in the 24th century. One of the regulations observed aboard these ships, contrary to that aboard Federation starships, was that no officer would report an out of the ordinary occurrence until he had a full analysis and resolution.
The Birdseye-type space module was a type of artificial satellite used during the late 20th century and in the late 24th century.
The Bok'Nor-type of Cardassian freighter was a starship used by the Cardassians during the latter half of the 24th century.
A Bolian freighter was a type of freighter utilized by the Bolians during the mid-24th century.
A Bolian transport was a type of transport operated by the Bolians during the late 24th century.
A Bolian vessel was a type of starship operated by the Bolians during the 2370s.
The Borg cube was a type of starship used by the Borg Collective in the 24th century. Along with the Borg sphere, cubes were among the primary types of vessel for its fleet. (; )
The Borg probe was a type of manned probe starship used by the Borg Collective in the 24th century.
The Borg Queen's ship was an octahedron-shaped starship that was used by the Borg Collective in the 24th century.
The Borg scout ship was a type of starship used by the Borg Collective. The ship massed approximately 2.5 million metric tons.
The Borg long-range tactical vessel, commonly referred to by the Federation as a Borg sphere, was a sphere-shaped starship used by the Borg Collective during the late 24th century.
The Borg class 4 tactical vessel, or Borg tactical cube, was a type of heavily-armed Borg cube utilized by the Borg Collective in the 24th century.
Designated by Starfleet as the Borg type 03, this class of Borg starship was used by a rogue Borg faction led by Lore.
The bortaS bir class was a type of warship used by the Klingon Empire during the mid-23rd century.
A Boslic freighter was a type of freighter used by the Boslics during the 2370s.

The Bothan starships were illusory vessels created by a telepathic member of the Botha during his encounter with in 2372. Only one of the ships actually existed, the other two being figments of the crew's imagination caused by the Bothan's psionic field. ()
The Bradbury class was a class of Federation transport ships developed during the latter half of the 24th century.
The Breen interceptor was a type of light warship that served as the backbone of the Breen Confederacy fleet in the late 24th century.
A Breen warship was a type of warship utilized by the Breen Confederacy during the mid-24th century. This class of vessel was armed with phasers. ()
The Brenari freighter was a class of cargo ship in use by the Brenari during the late-24th century.
The Briori ship was a type of starship used by the Briori in the 20th century. According to John Evansville, their ships were not unlike .
The Brunali transport vessel was a class of starship in use by the Brunali until at least 2376.
A Byzatium transport was a type of transport utilized during the late 24th century.

A Caatati vessel was a class of starship that was operated by the Caatati refugees following their assimilation by the Borg in 2373. In all thirty Caatati ships, both small and large, transported the last remaining Caatati refugees from the aftermath of the destruction of their homeworld, including several vessels of this larger type.
The California class, nicknamed the Cali class, was a type of Federation starship in service during the late 24th century. They were support ships designed for second contact missions. ()
The Cardassian ATR-4107 was an incredibly advanced unmanned Cardassian prototype self-guided tactical missile designed in 2369. ()
The Cardassian escape pod was a small Cardassian spacecraft used to evacuate a ship during an emergency. This type of escape pod measured five meters in length.

A Cardassian patrol cruiser was a type of patrol ship employed by the Cardassian Union during the 24th century, primarily used for patrolling and policing the Demilitarized Zone. They were much larger than Cardassian shuttles. ()
Cardassian pursuit vessels were a type of starship employed by the Cardassian Union, during the 24th century.

A Cardassian supply ship was a type of Cardassian transport ship utilized by the Cardassian Union during the 24th century. These freighters had minimal weaponry, and were manned with a crew of about fifty.
A Cardassian workbee was a small craft used by the Cardassian Union during in the late 24th century.
The Cardenas-class was a type of 23rd century Federation starship in use during the 2250s.
A cargo drone was a type of 23rd century and 24th century automated cargo vessel utilized by the Federation.
The Challenger-class starships were Starfleet vessels in service in the later 24th century. They shared many design aspects with and starships.
The chargh class was a type of battle cruiser used by the Klingon Empire during the mid-23rd century. It was similar to the , but with a reduced central hull.
The Charon-type was a starship design that was in service to the Terran Empire in the mid-23rd century.
A Cheron scout vessel was a type of durable long-service starship utilized by Commissioner Bele, the Chief Officer of the Commission on Political Traitors on planet Cheron.
The Chessu ship was a type of starship utilized by the Chessu, who employed the class in the Delta Quadrant during the late 24th century.
The Cheyenne class was a type of starship in service with Starfleet during the late 24th century.
A Chokuzan vessel was a type of ship belonging to the Chokuzans.
The Class 1 shuttle was an early design of Federation shuttlecraft, described as already being "old" during the first half of the 24th century.
A class 1 transport was a type of unarmed spacecraft used by the Brunali in the late 24th century. This spacecraft, at a minimum, could support one lifeform.
The Class 2 shuttle, also referred to as a Type 9 shuttlecraft, was a short range auxiliary space vessel utilized by Starfleet for use as an embarked craft from starships.

Class-4 stardrive vessel was the designation for a type of small 23rd century spaceship, utilized by the Federation Merchant Service for the role of survey vessel. This class of vessel was equipped with transporters and utilized iridium in its construction.

A Class 7 vessel was a Starfleet designation for a type of interplanetary sublight spacecraft, used during the 24th century. These vessels were typically armed with lasers and were manned with a small crew of about two dozen. Overall, they were slightly faster than Class 9 cargo vessels.

A Class 9 cargo vessel was the Starfleet designation for a type of interplanetary sublight freighter utilized during the 24th century. These type of vessels had minimal weaponry, including lasers, and were typically slower than Class 7 vessels.
The Class A shuttlecraft was a type of warp-capable shuttlecraft used by the Terran Empire. The shuttle came equipped with transporters.
The Class C shuttlecraft was a commonly used Starfleet and civilian shuttlecraft from the mid-23rd century through the late-24th century.
The Class F shuttlecraft was the standard issue Starfleet shuttlecraft during the mid-23rd century.

A Class III neutronic fuel carrier or 3rd class neutronic fuel carrier was the designation used to classify a type of 23rd century fuel carrier capable of hauling several metric tons of neutronic fuel as well as several hundred passengers.
The class J starship, or class J cargo ship or Class J training ship, was a small, antiquated starship design used by the Federation and independent traders alike well into the mid-23rd century. (; )
The Constellation-class starship was a type of Federation star cruiser employed by Starfleet from the late 23rd century through the late 24th century.
The Constitution-class was a Federation , Class I heavy cruiser that was utilized as premier exploratory Starfleet vessels during the mid-23rd century.

The Constitution II class1 was a Federation heavy cruiser operated by Starfleet from the late 23rd to the middle of the 24th century. At first, it was considered a refit of the original , but by 2401, it had been retroactively deemed to be a class in and of itself.

The Constitution III class, also known as the Neo-Constitution class, was a Federation starship that served as an exploration vessel and was operated by Starfleet during the 24th and 25th centuries. (; )
The Coridan ship was a class of starship in use by the Coridanites during the mid-22nd century.
Corvallen freighters were types of warp-capable freighters utilized by Corvallen mercenaries during the 24th century. One type they used was the old-style Antares-class freighter.

The Courage-class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 31st century into the 33rd century. Its design featured a vertically-oriented diamond-shaped primary hull, with an engineering hull protruding aft from the middle.
Coverian freighters were a type of freighters operated by the Coverians.
The CR-721 type escape pod was a type of escape pod used aboard the Federation communication relay station CR-721. Only one escape pod of this type was stowed aboard this type of station. ()
The Cravic ship was a type of starship initially utilized by the Cravic, nearly identical to Pralor vessels.

The Crossfield class was a type of Federation starship in service during the mid-23rd century. Though officially designated as a science vessel, during the the class was re-classified as a warship. ()
The Curiosity class was a Federation heavy cruiser operated by Starfleet during the late 24th century.

The cytoplasmic lifeform vessel was a type of ship operated by cytoplasmic lifeforms native to an area of the Delta Quadrant. It was equipped with a weapon capable of draining an enemy ship's energy reserves.

The D'deridex class, alternately known as the B-type warbird, or warbird class starship, was one of the largest and most powerful mainstays of the Romulan Star Empire. It served as the backbone of the Romulan fleet during the latter half of the 24th century.
The D'Kora-class Marauder was a type of advanced starship utilized by the Ferengi Alliance during the 24th century. (; )
The D'Kora-type shuttle was a type of auxiliary craft attached to Marauder. Tarr's Marauder was equipped with such a vessel in 2364. ()
The D'kyr-type was a type of Vulcan starship operated by the High Command during the mid-22nd century. Some of these vessels were given the designation of combat cruiser in the 2150s. ()
The D'kyr-type support craft was a relatively large mid-22nd century support craft carried aboard Vulcan starships. The support craft was docked inside the engine hoop of its mother ship. ()

The D'Vahl-type was a class of Vulcan starship utilized from the mid-20th through the mid-22nd centuries. This multipurpose vessel served as a survey vessel during the late-1950s. () During the 2150s, it was used by the Vulcan High Command as a patrol ship utilized for patrol duties and orbital defense of . ()
The D4 class was a type of small Klingon patrol ship used by the Klingon Empire in the in the mid 23rd century. ()
The D5-class battle cruiser was a type of large warship that was in service with the Klingon Imperial Fleet during the mid-22nd century.
The D7 class cruiser was a 23rd century warship originally designed and used by the Klingon Imperial Fleet, before being used by the Romulan military during the late 2260s.

The Daedalus-class was an early class of Starfleet vessel that, unlike most Federation starship designs, was designed with a spherical primary hull, outwardly similar to the later . This class, which operated with a crew of approximately 229, had a unique subspace distress call among starship classes. ()
The Danube-class, also known as Runabout-class, was a type of Federation runabout in operation during the latter half of the 24th century.
The Dauntless-class was a class of Federation starship operated during the late 24th century.

classes.n: Deep Space Repair Beta Six escape vessel
classes.intro: The Deep Space Repair Beta Six escape vessel was a type of escape vessel used on the Federation Deep Space Repair Beta Six to evacuate the station during an emergency.

The Defiant-class warship, officially an escort vessel, began development in 2366 as a small, highly powered, heavily armed warship intended to defend the against the Borg. The was the prototype of what was to be a new Federation battle fleet. However, the ship had numerous design problems that were made apparent during its shakedown cruise. These flaws, combined with the decreased urgency of the Borg threat, caused Starfleet to table its plans for a battle fleet and put the Defiant in storage. ()
A Dekendi transport was a type of transport-ship utilized by the Dekendi during the mid-22nd century.

The Delta Flyer escape pod was a one-person escape pod assigned to the Federation shuttle , attached to the . The Delta Flyer carried at least three such pods, which were equipped with a phaser, a tricorder, and enough emergency rations to allow someone to survive for less than ten days. ()

The Delta Flyer-type was a Starfleet shuttlecraft designed and built by the crew of the during the vessel's stay in the Delta Quadrant, from which its name was derived. Two vessels of this type were constructed during Voyagers return to Earth from the Delta Quadrant.
The Delta IV was an American expendable rocket of the early 21st century. The rockets were produced by United Launch Alliance.

The Delta Rana warship was an illusory starship created by the Douwd who had taken the form of Kevin Uxbridge. He used the illusion as a form of planetary defense system for Rana IV against the . It was noted to have five times the mass of the Enterprise. ()
The Deltan ship was a starship class in use by the Deltans in the mid-22nd century.
The Denebian patrol ship was a type of patrol ship used by the Denebians of Deneb V. This spacecraft was equipped with weapons.
The Denebian spaceship was a type of spaceship used by the Denebians during the 2260s.
The Denobulan medical ship was a type of warp-capable shuttle used by the Denobulans to transport medical supplies.
The Denobulan shuttle was a type of warp-capable vessel used by the Denobulans during the mid-22nd century.

The Devore scout ship or Devore shuttle was a type of warp-capable scout ship used by Devore military officers in the late 24th century. It was operated by a single person and was capable of landing. The ship was armed and had deflector shields.
The Devore warship was a type of warship used by the Devore Imperium to patrol their territory in the Delta Quadrant. They sometimes operated in squadrons.
The dilithium barge was a Klingon cargo ship type in operation during the mid-22nd century.
The Dralian vessel was a class of starship in use by the Dralian people in the late-24th century.
The Dramen patrol ship was a small one-man spacecraft designed for patrol duty in the Dramen star system. This type of craft was slightly larger than a Federation shuttlecraft.
A Drayan shuttle was a small, armed shuttle used by the Drayans. It was capable of space travel as well as maneuvering inside a planet's atmosphere. ()
A Drayan starship was a type of starship utilized by the Drayans during the 24th century.

The Dreadnought-class was an experimental class of dreadnought warship designed by Section 31 of Starfleet with the help of . The only known vessel of this class, the , was launched from a secret facility orbiting Io in 2259. ()
The Dream Alien ship was a type of starship encountered in the communal dream experienced by the crew in 2374.
The Dresselhaus type was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 31st century into the 33rd century.
The Drookmani ship was a type of starship used by Drookmani scavengers for their salvage operations during the late 24th century.

The Drookmani shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft used by Drookmani scavengers in the late 24th century. Such a shuttle was stowed in a ventral bay on the command section of the Drookmani ship. It could land on a planetary surface and hold at least three occupants.
The Duderstadt class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the early 25th century.
The DY-100 class was an early design of Earth pre-warp vessels that were in operation during the late 20th century.
The DY-1200 was a type of Earth starship that was utilized during the 22nd century. One DY-1200 ship, the , was engaged in stellar chart mapping in ectors 184/02–185/38 in 2160. (, okudagram)
The DY-245 was a type of Earth starship that was utilized during the 22nd century. (, okudagram)
The DY-430 was a type of Earth starship that was utilized during the 22nd century. In use as early as 2146, mission profiles included nebula survey projects. ( okudagram)

The DY-500 was a type of Earth starship that was utilized for early deep space exploration and colonization during the 22nd century. In use as early as 2102, this class was considerably more advanced than the older 20th century . (; okudagram)

The DY-732 was a type of Earth starship that was utilized during the 22nd century. They were in use as early as 2105, and were suitable for colonization missions as well as diplomatic roles. ( okudagram)
The DY-950 was a type of Earth starship that was utilized during the 22nd century. (, okudagram)
The Echelon class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the early 25th century.

The Edison-class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the early 25th century. It bore a strong resemblance to the 23rd century but featured components and technology from more recent designs.

The Eisenberg class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 31st century and into the 33rd century. Its primary hull had a tapered upward-sloping shape, with two disconnected warp nacelles.

Ekosian missiles were thermonuclear missiles used by the Ekosians during their Nazi era. Even though the nuclear missiles were created on Ekos. One of the missiles was launched against the after it was detected approaching Ekos in 2268.
The Ekosian ship was a type of spacecraft with interplanetary capability from the planet Ekos.
An Elasian ship was a type of sublight spacecraft utilized by the Elasians during the mid-23rd century.
The Elkins type was a preliminary designation for a group of Federation starships in use during the Dominion War. ()
The Emmette type was a type of starship operated on Earth and by the Terran Empire before the of starships.
The Engle-class was a type of Federation starship in service during the 2250s.
Enolian patrol ships were a type of heavily armed patrol ships utilized by the Enolian Guard for patrol duty during the mid-22nd century.
The Enolian prison transport was a type of prison transport used by the Enolian Guard to move groups of people to prison colonies from Keto-Enol, as crime was rampant in their system.

The Enolian shuttle was a small shuttlecraft utilized by some Enolians, but not by the Enolian Guard. It was capable of warp speed and was equipped with fore and aft particle cannons. It was capable of holding at least sixteen occupants.

The Erewon class was a type of Federation civilian personnel transport operated during the 24th century that could be used as a colony ship. The Erewon class was about four times larger than a runabout.
The Etanian starship was a class of starship in use by the Etanians in the late-24th century.

The Excelsior-class was a type of Federation starship used by Starfleet between the late 23rd and late 24th centuries. It was the backbone of Starfleet for over a century, making it one of the fleet's longest-serving and most recognizable starship designs.
The Excelsior II class was a Federation starship class that was in service with Starfleet by the early 25th century.
The Eymorg starship was a highly advanced starship operated by the Eymorg of Sigma Draconis VI during the mid-23rd century.
The Falcon 9 was a rocket type of the early 21st century.

The Federation attack fighter was a type of small Federation starship utilized by civilians and Starfleet alike, as well as by Starfleet Academy, where they were used as Academy flight trainers. They were classified by Starfleet as an attack fighter, and were prominently featured during the Dominion War. ()
A Federation cargo shuttle was a shuttlecraft type operated by Starfleet in the 2250s and 2260s. Military shuttles used the same basic frame. (, )

A Federation cargo vessel was a class of cargo vessel operated by the Federation during the mid-23rd century that was used for hauling radioactive ore. Due to the nature of its function, the ship's hull was transport resistant and was equipped with minimal .
The Federation-class was a type of 23rd century Federation dreadnought-type starship constructed by Starfleet.
The Federation holoship was a prototype Federation starship first launched in early 2375.
The Federation mission scoutship was a type of Federation scout ship in operation by Starfleet during the late 24th century.

A Federation scout ship was a type of small Federation-built one-man scout ship of common design, utilized during the latter half of the 23rd century by Federation citizens. The ships of this class were not capable of outrunning a Klingon battle cruiser for long periods of time.

A Federation tug was a class of small specialized tug starships used exclusively for towing damaged or disabled vessels. These ships were used by the Federation and operated by Starfleet in the 24th century.

The Fenris Ranger vessel was a class of warp-capable vessel utilized by the Fenris Rangers during the late 24th and early 25th centuries. They were armed with directed energy weapons and flown with a single pilot. They had the capacity to carry cargo, but did not have transporter capabilities and were thus required to dock with other vessels in order to board them.
The Ferengi cargo ship was a was a generic term used to described any type of cargo ship used in the Ferengi Alliance during the mid-24th century.

A Ferengi casino ship was a starship type operated by the Ferengi Alliance. It was a mobile gambling platform built to accommodate large numbers of passengers and featuring a variety of games and other entertainments such as dabo.
A Ferengi garbage scow was a type of garbage scow utilized by the Ferengi as a means of controlling their waste management.

The Ferengi shuttle, also sometimes referred to as a Ferengi pod or Ferengi ship was a warp-capable shuttlecraft used as an auxiliary vehicle and utilized by prominent businessmen in the Ferengi Alliance during the latter half of the 24th century.
In starship classification, a fighter shuttle was a shuttlecraft intended for combat situations.
The Flaxian ship was a type of starship employed by Flaxian assassin Retaya. The ship had a magneton relay.
The Freedom class was a small starship design operated by Starfleet in the mid-22nd century. After the formation of the in 2161, the Freedom-class cruiser was in the .

The Friendship class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 31st century into the 33rd century. Its design consisted solely of a saucer-shaped primary hull with an empty center, and two detached nacelles at the aft.
A Frunalian science vessel was a type of science vessel in operation during the 24th century.
The Gagarin class was a type of Federation starship that was in operation with Starfleet in the early 25th century.
Galador freighters were vessels utilized by the Galadorans during the 24th century.

The Galaxy-class was a Starfleet heavy capital ship class first introduced in the mid 2360s. It was one of the largest and most powerful Federation starship classes of its time, with many serving in the Dominion War. Starfleet had previously operated another type of starship in the 2250s. ()
Galipotan freighters were a class of freighter operated by the Galipotans during the late 24th century.
Galor-class cruisers were the primary class of warship used by the Cardassian military during the latter half of the 24th century.
A Gavarian ship was a type of starship utilized during the mid-22nd century.
Gelrakian boarding pods were auxiliary craft integrated into Gelrakian ships that were used for transporting Gelrakian boarding parties onto enemy vessels.
A Gelrakian ship was a type of starship of Gelrakian origin utilized during the late 24th century.
The Gemini capsule was a mid-20th century space capsule used by NASA for the Gemini Project, the second manned program in the space agency's history.
A Golorian trading vessel was a type of freighter employed in the Delta Quadrant during the late 24th century.
The Gorn destroyer was a type of massive warship employed by the Gorn Hegemony during the 23rd century.

A Gorn trading vessel was a type of raider utilized by the Gorn Hegemony during the mid-23rd century for conducting raids. The Gorn ship was designed with four nacelles, and its class configuration was unfamiliar to the Federation prior to the late 2260s. ()
The Gorn warship was a type of warship utilized by the Gorn of the mirror universe during the 22nd century.
The Groumall type was a type of starship utilized throughout the Cardassian Union during the late 24th century.
A Haakonian shuttle was an interstellar vessel used by the Haakonians. The vessel was small enough in size to be towed into the shuttlebay of an starship.
An Orion barge was an Orion starship that was in service from the 2150s to the 2380s.

The Hazari shuttle was an advanced shuttle used by Hazari bounty hunters. This two person craft was equipped with advanced directed energy weapons, and was small enough in size to be towed into the shuttlebay of an starship.
The Hazari vessel was a heavily armed starship used by Hazari bounty hunters, equipped with advanced directed energy weapons, spatial charges, and a tractor beam.
A Hekaran starship was a type of starship employed by the Hekarans during the late 24th century. These ships were equipped with transporter systems, and could be operated by a single crewmember.
The Hermes-class was a type of 23rd century Federation scout ship operated by Starfleet.
The Hiawatha type was a Federation medical frigate operated by Starfleet during the 2250s and 2260s.
The Hideki-class was a warp-capable multipurpose starship used by the Cardassian Union's military during the late 24th century.
The Hierarchy survey vessel was a type of starship utilized by the Overlookers.
A Hirogen ship or Hirogen vessel was a type of small, heavily-armed hunting vessel used by Hirogen s during the 2370s as they hunted prey throughout the Delta Quadrant.
The holograms' ship was Hirogen starship that was commandeered by Iden and a number of Hirogen-created holograms in 2377. It was the vehicle used to drive Iden's Rebellion. ()
The Hoover class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet in the mid-23rd century.

The Hunters' ship was a type of starship utilized by the Gamma Quadrant species, known simply as the Hunters, during the late-24th century. It was equipped with an emitter that could fire an unusual type of radiation at a target, with the effect of reversing the polarity of their shields allowing for transporters to penetrate. When in motion, the ship's engines also gave off detectable ionized L-band emissions, identical to that of the Tosk's ship.
The Huron-type was a small 23rd century Federation starship identified as a freighter.

Husnock warships were large starships operated by the Husnock prior to 2366. This type of vessel was much larger than a starship, capable of being seen from the surface while in orbit, and capable of destroying all life on a planet.

The Illyrian starship was a class of starship utilized by the Illyrians during the mid-22nd century. This class of vessel was equipped with a minimal armament of particle weapons and was tactically inferior to an starship. This class was also notable for having its primary warp coil, which was tied into the ship's injector system, protected by a force field.
The Imhotep ship was a vessel used by the Imhotep species of the Delta Quadrant.
The Inquiry class was a type of starship operated by Starfleet during the late 24th and early 25th centuries. ()
An inspection pod was a type of auxiliary craft used by Starfleet in the 22nd century.

The Intrepid-class starship was a Federation design that entered service in the latter half of the 24th century. The Intrepid class was designed for long-term exploration missions. At less than half the size of a starship, it was considered "quick and smart." ()
The Intrepid type was a starship type in service with the United Earth Starfleet in the mid-22nd century. The class was armed with phase cannons and two torpedo launchers. ()

The Intrepid-type escape pod was a type of escape pod used aboard and starships in the late 24th century. In the event of a ship-wide catastrophe, the pods could be launched as a last resort to save the crew. Once deployed, the pods were vulnerable to attack or becoming engulfed in the destruction of the parent ship. As in other types of Starfleet escape craft, the pods were equipped with thrusters, providing some chance of fleeing the field of combat. However, without warp drive, survivors were reliant on larger ships for ultimate rescue.
An Iyaaran shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft, capable of impulse speeds, in use by the Iyaarans in 2370. ()

The J-class was a starship design of Earth origin utilized by the Earth Cargo Service as a freighter. They were operated by captains with an Earth Cargo Authority license. These vessels had a history dating back to the early 22nd century, with one of the ships of the class, the , commissioned in 2102. ()
J'naii shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft, not capable of interstellar travel, in use by the J'naii in 2368. These J'naii shuttles carry plestorene-based backup systems. ()

The jach class was a type of battle cruiser used by the Klingon Empire during the mid-23rd century. It was similar to the ship, but could be differentiated by the presence of a third, central hull between the two outer hulls.
The Jelinian freighter was a type of cargo ship in use by the Jelinians in the late-24th century.
The Jem'Hadar battle cruiser was a type of large battleship used by the Dominion during the late 24th century.
The Jem'Hadar or Dominion battleship was a type of warship introduced in the Alpha Quadrant in 2374, shortly after the outbreak of the Dominion War.

A Jem'Hadar fighter, or Jem'Hadar attack ship, was a small type of warship that formed the bulk of the Dominion fleet. These versatile starships were also known to perform the roles of patrol ships and scout ships.
Juhryan freighters were a type of 24th century freighter hailing from Juhraya.
A jumpship was a type of small atmospheric shuttlecraft that could be operated by a single pilot. Jumpships were used by Starfleet as emergency evacuation craft in the late 2250s of the .

A K'normian trading ship was a type of shuttle built by the K'normians for the purpose of ferrying cargo and passengers. The ship's power was derived from fuel cells. In the cockpit, the pilot's console was at the front, with the engineering console to the left and the communications console to the right. The ship had no offensive capabilities.
The K't'inga-class battle cruiser was a primary class of warship in service with the Klingon Imperial Fleet in the 23rd century, and with the Klingon Defense Force in the mid-to-late 24th century.
K'toch class was a type of one-man Klingon scout ship in service during the mid-22nd century.
The KVort type escape pod was an escape pod used by the Klingons aboard their Birds-of-Prey.
The Kaelon warship was a type of warship used by the Kaelons during the 24th century. These starships were capable of landing on planetary surfaces.
Kago's starship was a mid-22nd century vessel operated by the bounty hunter Kago.
A Kalandan supply ship was a type of supply ship operated by the Kalandans during the 1st millennium BC.
The Kantare escape pod was a type of escape pod used by the Kantare.

The Kantare supply ship was a type of unarmed supply ship used by the Kantare to transport supplies from planet to planet during the early 22nd century. They were equipped with escape pods for use in an emergency. The ship's hull was composed of duratanium and beryllium.
The Kaplan F17 Patrol Frigate was a type of patrol frigate used by the Confederation of Earth in the early alternate 25th century. ()
The Kaplan F17 Speed Freighter was a type of civilian starship used in the late 24th century.
The Karemma ship was a type of vessel utilized by the Karemma during the late 24th century.
The Karemma transport was a type of transport utilized by the Karemma during the late 24th century.

Karla Five's vessel was an advanced starship from the antimatter universe planet . The vessel was capable of operating with only a single pilot and was capable of transporting only a few passengers. Its maximum warp was warp 36, and it was equipped with enough positive matter armament to ignite a dead star into life.
A Kartelan freighter was a type of freighter in service during the late 24th century.
The Kazon fighter or Kazon shuttle was a small spacecraft originally used by the Trabe.
A Kazon frigate was a type of frigate operated by the Kazon during the latter half of the 24th century.
The Kazon raider, also identified as a Kazon warship, Kazon patrol vessel, or patrol ship, was a type of small raider of Trabe origin. ()

A Kazon ship was a type of small starship of Trabe origin that later fell into the hands of the Kazon after they overthrew the Trabe in 2346. () Ships of this type collected The Unwanted for The Diviner. ()
A Kazon shuttle was a type of auxiliary craft utilized by the Kazon during the 2370s. These vessels were smaller in size than a Kazon raider, and could be manned by a crew of as many as three.
The Keldon-class cruiser was a class of Cardassian warship utilized by the Cardassian military during the 2370s.
A Kellenite ship was a type of vessel operated in the 22nd century.
The Kelvan life craft was a type of escape pod used by the Kelvan people on their multi-generational starships.

The Kelvin pod was a type of escape pod that was attached to the in 2263. Kelvin pods were stowed beneath the bridge of the ship, allowing quick egress for the command crew in the circumstances of a catastrophic event.
The Kelvin type was a class of Federation survey vessel operated by Starfleet in the 2230s.
The Kelvin-type shuttlecraft was a shuttlecraft type in use aboard the in 2233.
A Kinjal frigate was a type of frigate operated by the Kinjal during the 24th century.
The Klaestron starship was a mid-sized vessel used by the Klaestron during the 24th century. It had a high warp capability; able to achieve warp 5 or better.
The Klingon Bird-of-Prey was a class of warship utilized by the Klingons, from at least the mid 22nd century through the late 32nd century, having undergone numerous design changes in that timeframe.
A Klingon civilian transport ship was a type of civilian transport, utilized in the Klingon Empire during the late 24th century.

The Klingon cleave ship was a type of Klingon warship in service during the 23rd century. Massive in size, it mounted a large vertical blade on its bow that enabled it to ram and destroy opposing starships.

The Klingon raider was a small starship used by the Klingons in the mid-23rd century. It was often carried aboard larger Klingon ships as an auxiliary craft. The ship was equipped with an antimatter power supply and were capable of achieving warp speeds. Its cockpit had seating for two, though it could be operated by only one individual. () It was classified as a shuttle. The craft's blade-like "wings" would flutter during atmospheric flight. ()
The Klingon shuttlecraft was a type of small craft in use by the Klingons during early 22nd century.

The Klingon transport was a type of small transport utilized within the Klingon Empire during the mid-22nd century. This type of vessel was characterized by a long fuselage section capped by a small, conical cockpit on its forward section and two typical warp nacelles aft. The ship was green in color, similar to other Klingon ships of that era.
The Klingon warbird was a warbird class used by the Klingon Empire in the mid-22nd century.
The Kobali shuttle was a shuttlecraft employed by the Kobali during the 2370s.
The Kobali starship was a type of starship utilized by the Kobali species in the Delta Quadrant. One ship could be overpowered by an starship. ()
A Kobheerian freighter was a freighter operated by the Kobheerians in the 24th century.
The Kobliad transport ship was a type of transport ship utilized by the Kobliad in the late-24th century.
The Korolev-class starship was a type of vessel in service with Starfleet during the 24th century. ()
The Kostolain starship was a class of starship in use by the Kostolain natives in the late-24th century.
A Kotakian starship was a type of starship operated during the late 24th century.
The Kovaalan starship was a type of armed starship used by the Kovaalans during the 22nd century.

The Kraylor medical transport was a class of warp-capable starship in use by the Kraylor in the late-24th century. They had few decks and their armament consisted of simple phasers. The Annari referred to this class vessel as a Kraylor warship. This class of vessel had multiple decks, warp 7+ capacity, was armed with phasers, and shields. The ship was also equipped with multiple escape pods and a shuttlebay large enough to carry the .
A Kreetassan starship was a type of starship utilized by the Kreetassans during the mid-22nd century. These vessels had warp capability and were about 100 meters long.
A Krenim patrol ship was a starship used by the Krenim in the Delta Quadrant in 2374.

The Krenim warship was a type of warship utilized by the Krenim during the 24th century. These vessels were larger and more powerful than an starship, due to, in part, their complement of chroniton torpedoes.

In several alternate timelines, the Krenim weapon ship was a warship of the Krenim Imperium capable of erasing civilizations from history. Its design and construction was spearheaded by Annorax, a military temporal scientist.
A Kressari freighter was a type of freighter used by the Kressari during the 24th century to haul mainly botanical DNA.

The Krios Battlecruiser was a type of battle cruiser used by the Kriosians during the mid-22nd century. Along with protecting Krios space, the Krios battlecruiser was also assigned the duty of protecting the First Monarch and the Kriosian royal family, which was known across hundreds of worlds.
A Kriosian ship was a type of starship utilized by the Kriosians during the latter half of the 24th century.
The Kriosian transport was a type of starship used by the Kriosian Sovereign Guard during the mid-22nd century.
Ktarian starships were small vessels used by the Ktarians during the 2360s. Their armaments were significantly inferior to the standard armaments found aboard a Federation starship. ()
Kukulkan's ship was a highly advanced starship controlled by the winged serpent creature Kukulkan.
A Kyrian fighter ship was a type of attack fighter used by the Kyrians in the 2370s.

The Kzinti police vessel was a type of starship utilized by the Kzinti. Following the Kzinti Wars, and in accordance to the Treaty of Sirius, Kzinti police vessels were the only type of military craft the Kzinti were allowed to possess.
The Lancelot class was a type of Federation starship in service during the late 23rd and early 24th centuries. It was based on the "venerable" design. ( display placard)

A landing pod or lander pod was a small utility craft in use by the Federation in the mid-23rd century. The pod comprised a spherical cockpit connected to an aft section containing four extendable stabilizing vanes, which could rotate freely around the cockpit to maintain position and attitude. Pods were equipped with both ejection and auto-navigation systems, though the navigation computers were susceptible to magnetic fields.
Laneth's starship was a type of small warship in the service of the Klingon Empire under the command of a Klingon Augment, Lieutenant Laneth. It was armed with disruptors.
Lazarus' spaceship was a domed, single-person ship operated by Lazarus and his antimatter universe counterpart, described as a timeship. ()
The Ledosian patrol ship was a type of starship class in use by the Ledosians in the late-24th century.
A Lissepian cargo ship was a starship operated by the Lissepians.
A Lissepian supply ship was a starship type operated by the Lissepians.
A Lissepian transport was a type of transport operated by the Lissepians.

The Lokirrim patrol ship was a type of medium-sized starship used by the Lokirrim to patrol their territory. The ship was equipped with a tractor beam and a photonic disruptor, which could be used to remotely decompile holograms. It was tactically outmatched by the starship.

The Lokirrim warship was a class of medium-sized starship utilized by the Lokirrim in their conflict with photonic insurgents. The ship was equipped with phasers and a photonic disruptor that could remotely decompile holograms, though it was no match for a Federation starship.
A long range shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft operated by the Federation in the 23rd and 24th centuries. Some of these ships were used as couriers. ()
The Lotus Flower class was a classification of starship used by the Federation.
The Luna-class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the late 24th century.
Lysian destroyers were short-range attack vessels, utilized by the Lysian Alliance during the late 24th century, that had a standard crew complement of fifty-three.
The Magee class was a type of 23rd century Federation science vessel in use during the 2250s. At least two ships of this class remained in service through the 2380s.
The Majalan combat cruiser was a type of small warship fielded by the dissident Majalan colony on Prospect VII in the 23rd century. ()

The Majalan shuttle was a type of small spacecraft used by the Majalans in the 23rd century. It had capacity for one pilot and at least two passengers, and was capable of atmospheric flight and landing.
The Malachowski class was a type of 23rd century Federation starship that was in service during the 2250s.

The Malcorian warp ship was the prototype of the Malcorian Space Bureau's first Malcorian warp driven starship that was scheduled for launch in the late 2360s. Its first planned destination according to Malcor III's Space Administrator Mirasta Yale was to be the nearby Garth system.
The Malon escape pod was a type of small escape pod used on some types of Malon export vessels.

The Malon export vessel was a large freighter operated by the waste export industry of the Malon they were nothing more than a garbage scow. The waste export vessel was designed for long range haulage and dumping of theta radioactive antimatter waste and other mixed industrial byproducts produced by the Malon civilization.

A Malon export vessel, eleventh gradient was a freighter-type vessel operated by the waste export industry of the Malon like most ships owned by the Malon it is classed as a garbage scow. They operated with a crew of nine.
The Malon shuttle was a shuttle created by the Malon in 2375 to withstand the pressure of a gas giant, so that the Malon ship could steal a multi-spatial probe.
The Malon transport ship was a type of ship in use by the Malon in the late-24th century.

The Malosian cargo shuttle was a cargo shuttle, supposedly of Malosian origin, used by the crew of to trick Degra into revealing information regarding the Xindi primary weapon. () The shuttle was similar in size, if slightly smaller, to a from Enterprise. (, et al.)
A Malurian shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft utilized by the Malurians in the 2150s. These vessels were capable of atmospheric entrance and were equipped with a cargo bay and a tractor beam system.

A Malurian vessel or Malurian ship was a type of armed starship utilized by the Malurians during the mid-22nd century. These large vessels were equipped with multiple weapon platforms which could fire ten powerful charges simultaneously. They were also able to generate defensive energy shields.
The Maquis fighter was a type of small and maneuverable shuttle used by the Federation and later commonly utilized by the Maquis as a fighter craft in their battle against the Cardassians.
A Maquis freighter was a type of ship used by the Maquis.
The Marauder-class attack cruiser was a fictional starship class devised by Nog during an interrogation by Wainwright in 1947.
The Mark IV liferaft was a type of 23rd century Federation escape pod.

The Mars class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 32nd century into the 33rd century. It featured a diamond-shaped primary hull, with detached chevron-shaped nacelles each to the lower port and starboard.
A Mawasi cruiser was a type of cruiser utilized by the Mawasi species during the late 24th century.
The Mayflower type was a starship class in service to Starfleet in the mid-23rd century. This design had two nacelles connected to the underside of the primary hull by swept pylons.
The Maymora-class was a type of Vulcan starship.

Mazarite ships were a type of starship utilized by the Mazarite High Council's government, which was highly corrupt, during the mid-22nd century. Because the Mazarites of the 2150s were technologically far less advanced than the Vulcans of the same era, several Mazarite ships could easily be outmatched and disabled by a single Vulcan combat cruiser.
A Mazarite shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft stowed aboard Mazarite ships.

A medical shuttle was a shuttlecraft, equipped with specialized technology and equipment designed to deal with possible medical emergencies, carried aboard Federation starships in the early 23rd century.

The Medusan vessel was a type of starship in operation during the 23rd and 24th centuries. Sharing some commonalities with Federation starship design, the vessel functioned under the authority of the Medusans. It was capable of landing on a planetary surface. ()
Menos' ship was a small transport operated by the rogue Vulcan, Menos in the 22nd century.
The Merced-class starship was a type of vessel in service with Starfleet during the 24th century. ()
The Mercury-Redstone Launch Vehicle was an American expendable rocket that was in service with NASA in the mid-20th century.
The Merian class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 31st century into the 33rd century. Its design featured a flat primary hull with four disconnected nacelles.
The military shuttle was a shuttlecraft type operated by Starfleet in the 2250s. Federation cargo shuttles used the same basic frame. (; )
A mining shuttle was a type of auxiliary craft used in mining.
The Miranda-class starship was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 23rd and the 24th century.
The Miranda type escape pod was a type of emergency escape vehicle used on starships.
The Mislenite freighter was a type of cargo ship used by the Mislenites in the late-24th century.
The Mithran-class was a fighter under development in 2374, said to be more advanced than any other warship in the quadrant.
The Model HB-88 was a 29th century Federation timeship.
The Monaveen-type was a class of cruiser utilized by the Hysperians during the late 24th century.

The Mondor type was a class of spacecraft utilized by the Pakleds during the mid- to late 24th century. By 2380, some had been augmented with random components stolen or salvaged from non-Pakled vessels, turning them into Pakled Clumpships.

A Monean research vessel was a type of spacecraft used by the Moneans during the 24th century. It was armed and capable of travel through both space and water, to depths up to a hundred kilometers. They posed no threat to an starship and could be easily destroyed.
A moon shuttle was an unsophisticated type of shuttlecraft that was used from the 22nd to the 24th century.
The Moore-type shuttlecraft was a shuttlecraft type operated by Starfleet in 2258.
A Mulzirak transport was a type of transport ship used during the 24th century.
The NAR18834 was a type of Earth starship that was utilized during the 22nd century. They were in use in diplomatic missions as early as 2120. (, okudagram)
Nausicaan ships were fighters employed by Nausicaan pirates during the mid-22nd century for raiding freighter trade routes.
The NCC-1701/3 type shuttlecraft was a shuttlecraft type used by Starfleet in 2269.
The NCIA-93 type was a class of Federation starship utilized by Section 31 during the 2250s.
The Nebula class was a type of Federation starship that was in service in Starfleet during the second half of the 24th century.
The Neptune-class starship was a class of United Earth survey ships that were in service with Starfleet around 2141.
The Nerada-type was a class of starship used by the Nasari during the late-24th century. They carried weapons which gave off a distinct tetryon signature when charging.
The New Orleans-class frigate was a Federation starship class that was in service during the mid-24th century. ()
The Newton type was a type of starship used by Starfleet in the mid-23rd century.
The Niagara class was a type of Starfleet vessel in service in the late 24th century. This class of starship had the unusual distinction of having three warp nacelles.
The Night Alien ship was a type of starship operated by the Night Aliens of the Delta Quadrant. Thousands of these ships resided in the region of space dubbed "" by the crew.
A Nihydron warship was a type of warship utilized by the Nihydron species during the late 24th century.
The Nimitz class was a type of 23rd century Federation capital ship in use during the 2250s and 2260s. (, )
The Nimitz-type escape pod was a type of emergency evacuation craft carried aboard , , and Federation starships in the mid-23rd century. (; )
The Norway class was a type of Federation starship in service with Starfleet during the 2370s.
The Nova class was a type of Federation starship designed for short-term planetary research missions. It was placed in service starting in the late 24th century.

The Numiri patrol ship was a small, standard vessel of the Numiri fleet. They were armed with directed-energy weapons comparable to an starship. They were also equipped with regenerative shields and tractor beams.
The Nuu'Bari mining vessel was a warp-capable 24th century starship operated by the Nuu'Bari.

The NX-class was a type of United Earth starship in Starfleet service during the mid-22nd century. The class is notable for having been the first to be constructed with the warp five engine, allowing Humanity to explore beyond neighboring star systems. The lead ship of the class, , was launched in 2151, weeks ahead of schedule, while the second, , was launched in 2154, after lengthy delays in drydock. ()
The NX type escape pod was a type of emergency escape craft installed aboard NX class starships in the 22nd century.
A Nyberrite Alliance cruiser was a type of starship used by the Nyberrite Alliance.

A Nygean prison ship was a starship operated by the Nygean Detention Force to transport prisoners from one planet to another, sometimes for execution. Nygean prison ships were capable of warp 8.2 and equipped with escape pods.
A Nygean starship was a class of vessel utilized by the Nygeans during the late 24th century.

The Nyrian biosphere vessel, also described as a habitat vessel, was a vast starship utilized by the Nyrians of the Delta Quadrant. It contained at least four decks, and corridors containing control terminals, and at least one more extensive control center (or what appeared like it).
The Obena class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the late 24th century to the early 25th century.
The Oberth class was a small Federation starship used primarily by Starfleet and civilian scientists alike, as a scout class and science vessel, from the late-23rd to the late-24th century.
The Odyssey class was a class of Federation starship that had entered service by the late 24th century. ()
Oh's warbird was a large warbird that served as General Oh's flagship as she led a fleet of 217 warbirds to Coppelius in 2399. ()
The Olympic class was a class of starship in service with Starfleet during the late 24th century.
Onquanii's ship was a type of starship utilized by Onquanii in the late 24th century.
The Federation orbital shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft utilized in and around Earth and the Spacedock One.
The Ord'mirit mining vessel was a type of ship in use during the late-24th century.
An Orion freighter was a type of freighter used by the Orions during the mid-22nd century.
Orion Interceptors were fast, moderately-armed starships used by the Orion Syndicate from the mid-22nd to late 24th centuries.
The Orion marauder was a type of starship utilized by the Orion Syndicate during the 22nd century.
An Orion vessel was a class of spacecraft used by Orion Syndicate. It was first encountered by the Federation in 2270, identified by its Orion markings.
An Ornaran freighter was a type of small impulse ship that was employed by the Ornarans. These freighters were equipped with transporters.
An Osaarian merchant ship was a type of starship utilized as part of the Osaarian merchant fleet during the mid-22nd century.
The Osler-type Federation starship was in use by Division 14 in the early 2380s.
The Pakled battle harpy was a type of attack fighter operated by the Pakleds in the late 24th century. They were warp-capable, and armed with twin directed energy weapons.

A Pakled Clumpship was an enhanced starship utilized by Pakled rebels during the 2380s, with the assistance of the rogue Klingon officer Captain Dorg. () These vessels began as craft, but were heavily fortified with new stolen or salvaged components. (, et al.)
The Pakled shuttle was a small auxiliary craft used by Pakleds in the late 24th century. It was capable of landing on a planetary surface, and was accessible through a large rear hatch.
A Pakled trade ship was a type of freighter utilized by the Pakleds during the mid-24th century.
A Pakled transport was a type of transport vessel utilized by the Pakleds during the mid-24th century.
The Par'tok type was a cargo vessel design utilized by the Klingon Empire from the 24th to the 32nd centuries. Unlike most Klingon starships, these freighters did not possess cloaking devices.
The Parliament class was a class of Federation starship that was in service during the late 24th century.
The Pathfinder class was a type of Federation starship that had entered service by the early 25th century. ()

The Pax class was a class of Federation starship that could also be configured as a space station operated by Starfleet during the 32nd century and into the 33rd century. It featured a central trunk, that could also blossom outward in a series of spiral arms.
A Pelian escort vessel was a type of starship utilized by the Pelians during the 2360s.

Penk's starship was a starship operated by an individual named Penk in the Delta Quadrant during the late 24th century. The starship was used as a main base of Tsunkatse matches, which took place on the ship but were transmitted live to millions of viewers over the sector. This vessel weighed about five million metric tons, and had reinforced hull plating protected by tetryon-based covariant shielding to prevent sensor penetration, with multiphasic force fields preventing the use of transporters. The ship was heavily armed with neutronic weaponry and a tetryon-based dampening field used to disable the engines, weapons, transporters and shields of ships in close proximity.

The Peregrine class was a type of courier ship appropriated by the Maquis as interceptors during the early 2370s. In some cases, the Maquis modified these vessels to include improved engine capability and light armaments. These vessels were commonly used during their insurrection against the Cardassian Union. ()
Personnel shuttles were specialized shuttle used by Starfleet to transport large numbers of personnel from one location to another.

The Phoenix warp ship was the first man-made, manned spacecraft to achieve light speed using warp drive. Constructed during the mid-21st century and launched in 2063, the Phoenix was remembered as the ship that instigated Earth's First Contact with Vulcans.
Phylosian ships were a type of interstellar space ship utilized by the Phylosians.
The Pioneer class was a class of Federation starship that was in operation with Starfleet sometime in the 23rd century.
The Pralor vessel was a type of starship initially utilized by the Pralor and were nearly identical to Cravic ships. They were crewed by Automated Personnel Units in the 2370s.
The Predator-class warship was a type of massive 24th century carrier vessel of Trabe origin.
In starship classification, a prison shuttle was a type of auxiliary craft employed for the transferring of prisoners between prison facilities.
The Promellian battle cruiser was a class of battle cruiser utilized by the Promellian military.

The Prometheus class was a highly classified Federation starship designed for deep space tactical assignments. It was one of the most advanced Starfleet vessels in operation during the later half of the 24th century, as well as later use in the 25th century, and in an alternate timeline of the 26th century.

The Protostar class was a small starship class launched by Starfleet during the late 24th century that was later approved for full production in 2384 after the destruction of the prototype and namesake vessel, the . ()
The Protostar type aquashuttle was a type of small shuttlecraft designed for traveling underwater and used on Federation starships.
The Protostar type escape pod was a type of emergency escape vehicle used on Federation starships to evacuate a ship during an emergency.

The Protostar type shuttlecraft was a type of small shuttlecraft used on Federation starships. In the construction of these ships, a vehicle replicator in the starship's shuttlebay might be utilized and the shuttle could be constructed in quick order. ()
The Provider class was a classification of starship used by the Federation.
The Ptolemy class was a type of Federation transport/tug utilized by Starfleet during the latter half of the 23rd century.
Qomar starships were a series of classes of vessels that were operated by the Qomar Planetary Alliance, usually staying within their system for xenophobic reasons. ()
The Qomar transport was a small starship used by the extremely xenophobic Qomar. They were designed to be used primarily within the Qomar system, but are occasionally used outside the system.

A Quarren coyote ship was a type of well-armed starship used by a band of criminals to abduct the crews of other starships and sell them into labor on Quarra. These ships used subspace mines to disable their target vessels, and were equipped with tractor beams.
A Quarren patrol ship was a type of 24th century patrol ship used by the for patrolling Quarra. ()
The Qugh class was a type of destroyer used by the Klingon Empire during the mid-23rd century.

The R'ongovian solar sailship was a type of solar sail-propelled starship employed by the R'ongovian Protectorate. In the mid-23rd century, the R'ongovian flagship was an antiquated solar sailship that was only used for ceremonial occasions. Per R'ongovian custom, after a treaty signing, the ship would fly the flag of their new allies as a tribute.
The Radiant class was a type of Federation starship that was in operation with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century. This class was equipped with four nacelles, similar to the later and .
The Rakhari shuttlecraft was a type of shuttle used by the Rakhari species.
The Rakosan fighter was a type of small piloted fighter used by the Rakosans. It was armed with a single directed energy weapon.
The Ramuran vessel was a type of starship used by Ramuran tracers in the late 24th century.
The Raptor-class scout vessel was a small battle cruiser utilized by the Klingon Empire during the mid-22nd century.
Raven-type starships were small, modular long-range Federation exploration vessels used in the mid-24th century.
The Ravinok type was a Cardassian ship design utilized by the Cardassian Union and operated by the Central Command during the mid-24th century.

The Red Lady type was a class of Romulan warbird used by the Romulan Free State and the Tal Shiar during the late 24th and early 25th centuries. These ships were decorated on the ventral hull with a painted bird-of-prey.
Rekag battle cruisers were a type of battle cruiser used by the Rekags during the mid-24th century.
Rekag shuttles were small craft utilized by the Rekags during the mid-24th century.
The Reliant class was a type of Federation starship that was in operation with Starfleet in the early 25th century.
The Renaissance class was a class of Federation starship that was in service with Starfleet during the 24th century.
A reptohumanoid vessel was a starship utilized by a reptohumanoid species in the Delta Quadrant.

The Retellian escape pod was a type of small escape pod used in the 22nd century to safely evacuate Retellian freighters in the case of an emergency. Two escape pods were directly accessible from a particular section aboard the Retellian freighter. They were not entirely visible from inside the freighter, where merely an access hatch leading to each of the two utility craft was visible.
A Retellian freighter was a type of freighter used by the Retellians from the 22nd to the 24th centuries.
The retrofitted dorsal carrier was a type of starship built in the future. The design number XRT-55D was connected to this carrier, with at least one commissioned in the year 3125.
The Rev-12 type was a type of starship used by the Vau N'Akat of Solum in the 25th century. ()

Rigel-class was the original intended starship class of the , as it was listed in an okudagram in , before the ship was seen in as an heavy cruiser. After a second appearance of the ship list in , the okudagram was corrected. A later version of the graphic listed the Zhukov correctly as an Ambassador-class starship.
The Rigelian freighter was a type of freighter that was operated by Rigelians during the 22nd century.

The Rigelian scoutship was a heavily-armed starship used under the authority of the Rigelian Trade Commission during the mid-22nd century. As scouts, these starships had small crew complements of around seventeen.
The Rockwell X-30 was a type of early Earth space shuttle.

The Romulan Bird-of-Prey was a type of space vessel that was in service with the military of the Romulan Star Empire during the late 23rd century. Surviving ships of the class continued to appear in various capacities through the 24th century.

The Romulan drone ship was an advanced experimental starship described as a marauder and developed by the Romulans in the 2150s. At the time, this ship class was identified as a marauder ship by Starfleet.
A Romulan interceptor was a type of starship used by the Romulan Star Empire in the 2370s.
The Romulan science ship was a type of science ship in service during the mid-to-late 24th century which was used to conduct standard and experimental research for the Romulan Star Empire.

The Romulan scout ship was a small scout ship used by the Romulan Star Empire during the latter half of the 24th century. This class of vessel rarely ventured out as far as the Romulan Neutral Zone. ()
The Romulan shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft used by the Romulan Star Empire in the 2370s.
The Romulan warbird was one of the starships the Romulan Empire used in the 22nd century.
A Romulan workbee was a small auxiliary craft used by the Romulans in the late 24th century. They featured a central forward external lighting, two control arms, and a large window for the pilot.
The Ross class was a type of Federation starship that was in operation with Starfleet in the early 25th century.
The RT-2203 was a type of Earth starship that was utilized during the 22nd century. In use as early as 2119, mission profiles included deep space exploration. ( okudagram)
Ru'afo's flagship was a medium-sized starship utilized by the Son'a during the late-24th century.
The Rukani vessel was a type of starship in use by the Rukani in the late-24th century.
The Rutian archaeological vessel was a type of specialized starship used by the Rutians for conducting archaeology missions.
An S-class shuttle was a type of small spacecraft used in the Federation, considered "old" by the late 24th century. It had two seats, no warp drive, and manual helm controls.
The Saber class was a class of Federation starship that was in service with Starfleet by the early 2370s.
The Sagan class was a type of Federation starship used by Starfleet in the early 25th century.
The Saladin-class destroyer was a type of starship operated by Starfleet for the during the 23rd century.
The Sarajevo-type starship was a class of warp driven vessel utilized by Earth during the mid-22nd century.

The Satarran starship was a small spacecraft used by the Satarrans. It could be piloted by one person and lacked discernible armament. However, it was equipped with an advanced sensor system that could remotely access the optical data network of a Federation starship, penetrate its shields, and alter computer records and memories.

The Saturn class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 31st century into the 33rd century. It featured a ring-shaped design with two nacelles connected at the aft directly to the primary hull.
The Saturn V was an American Human-rated expendable rocket that was in service with NASA in the mid-to-late 20th century. This rocket was used for the Apollo and Skylab programs.
The Scorpion-class vessels were small attack fliers stored aboard the Reman warbird Scimitar in 2379.
A drone ship was a type of auxiliary craft used by Section 31 Control in 2257 after going rogue.
Sentry pods were small, unmanned spacecraft used for defense, primarily deployed to intercept and prevent hostile incursions into a certain area.
Seronian fighter craft were a type of defensive starship used by the Seronians.

The Serosian vessel was a type of warp-capable starship used by the Serosians during the late-24th century. They operated with a crew of six and were usually equipped with isomorphs; holographic programs used for ship maintenance. 59.2 percent of the vessel's power reserves were dedicated to its life support systems.
The Sh'vhal type was a class of cruiser utilized by the Vulcan High Command during the late 24th century. This class of vessel was significantly larger in size than a starship.
A Sheliak colony ship was a type of starship used by the reclusive Sheliak species for the transport of "the membership", which was their term for "colonists".
The Shepard class was a type of Federation starship in service during the 2250s and 2260s.

The Shepherd ship was a type of starship used by the species in the mid-23rd century to protect ancient comets that they venerated as Arbiters of Life. These vessels were substantially larger and more technologically advanced than a Federation starship, endowed with superior speed and firepower. They were equipped with several forward torpedo launchers and a tractor beam.
A shuttle drone was a small Federation auxiliary craft employed during the 24th century and usually attached to a starbase or a space station. ()

In starship classification, a shuttlepod was a smaller type of shuttlecraft which was usually only capable of impulse speed or low-warp speeds. This designation was given to small craft that do not have passenger capacity like their larger relatives.
The Sikarian vessel was a small starship used by the Sikarians for interstellar travel.

The Singularity was a large Borg starship encountered by the Federation in the early 25th century. It was manned by a separate Borg Collective that originated from the assimilation in 2024 of Doctor Agnes Jurati by a Borg Queen from an alternate timeline in which she was the last surviving Borg. This new Collective was founded on the principles of cooperation and assimilating only the willing. ()
The Skagaran starship was a class of warp-capable ship in use by the Skagarans during the 19th century.
The vessels used by the Skrreea were of various designs.

The snakehead was a type of warp-capable scout ship employed by Romulans in the late 24th century. Despite its small size, it was heavily armed with twin retractable ventral-mounted disruptor cannons and featured double subthrusters. It was protected by deflector shields and a cloaking device, which could be reversed to project a false decoy image of the ship. It was operated by a single pilot.
The Snipe class was a classification of starship used by the Romulan military.
The Sombra class was a type of Federation starship in service with Starfleet during the 23rd century. In 2259, one such vessel was assigned to a mapping mission in non-Federation space. ()
