The Son'a battle cruiser was a type of large warship utilized by the Son'a. These vessels were armed with photon torpedoes and isolytic bursts, a variety of subspace weapon banned by the Second Khitomer Accords. Two of them outmatched a Federation starship.
The Son'a collector was a massive spacecraft designed by the Son'a to harvest metaphasic radiation from the rings of the planet , which conferred immortality.
The Son'a shuttles were medium-sized auxiliary craft utilized by the Son'a. These vessels were equipped with transporters and an indeterminate type of torpedo.
The Sovereign-class starship was introduced in the late 24th century, showcasing some of Starfleet's most recent technological advances.
The Sovereign-type escape pod was a type of escape pod used aboard , , , and starships. (; )
The Soyuz was a manned Russian spacecraft in service with the Soviet space program, and later the Russian Space Agency, in the 20th and 21st centuries.
A space capsule was a spacecraft vehicle or a component of a larger vehicle which was designed to protect, support, and transport astronauts to and from space.
A space shuttle orbiter was a type of low-orbit spacecraft developed on Earth by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration of the United States of America.

Species 10026 vessels were advanced starships utilized by Species 10026 during the latter half of the 24th century. These vessels were armed with modulating phaser pulses, which was considered by the Borg to be the vessel's tactical strength, as they were capable of penetrating Borg deflector shielding. The tactical weakness of these vessels was their lack of maneuverability.

A sentry vessel was a type of spacecraft used by a species in the Delta Quadrant which the Borg knew as Species 116. These vessels were posted at specific locations to prevent the passage of the Borg into the territory of Species 116.
The Species 6339 shuttle was a short-range craft used by a species known to the Borg as Species 6339.
The Species 6339 starship was a type of starship utilized by Species 6339.
The Species 8472 bio-ship was a type of organic-based vessel used by Species 8472 in large numbers during their invasion of the Milky Way Galaxy in 2373. ()

The Species 8472 energy focusing ship was a type of organic starship used by Species 8472. Similar in configuration to the more numerous bio-ship, it was also capable of crossing between normal space and fluidic space using quantum singularities.

Sphere-Builder vessels were armed starships used by the Sphere-Builders while they attempted to invade the Milky Way Galaxy in a possible alternate 26th century, part of their arsenal that also included the Delphic Expanse spheres. In the pivotal Battle of Procyon V, three different vessel designs were employed by the Sphere-Builders, with none of them being able to survive counterattacks from Federation forces. ()
The Springfield class was a type of Federation starship that was in service with Starfleet during the late 24th century. ()
The Srivani vessel was a type of small craft used by the Srivani in the late-24th century. It was equipped with stealth technology to render it invisible and intangible at a phase variance of 0.15.
The Stamets-type shuttlecraft was a shuttlecraft design in use by Starfleet in the 2250s and 2260s. ()
The Steamrunner class was a class of Federation starship that was in service with Starfleet by the early 2370s. By the 2380s, Starfleet had built a smaller variant of this class, the .
The Straleb security vessel was a Class 7 interplanetary starship commanded by Kushell, from the Legation of Unity, of the planet Straleb.
Subytt freighters were a type of freighter employed by the Subytts during the late 24th century.
Suliban cell ships were the primary ship types used by the during the mid-22nd century. They were armed with particle weapons and equipped with cloaking devices.
The Suliban freighter was a type of starship operated by the during the 22nd century.
The Suliban shuttle was a small spacecraft employed by the Suliban, capable of atmospheric flight and landing.

The Suliban stealth cruiser was a starship used by the Suliban . It was normally undetectable by Starfleet technology due to its cloaking device. Its armaments included four particle beam weapon banks. The standard crew complement was at least twenty.
The Suliban transport was a type of transport vessel in use by the Suliban in the mid-22nd century.
The Surak-class was a type of Vulcan starship used by the High Command during the mid-22nd century.
The Sutherland class was a type of Federation starship that was in operation with Starfleet in the early 25th century.

The Suurok-class was a type of Vulcan starship designated by the High Command as a science vessel as early as 2136, and additionally used as a combat cruiser into the mid-22nd century. () At least some ships of the class remained in service well into the late 24th century. ()
Swarm ships were small, two-person craft left in large numbers on Altamid by the planet's original inhabitants sometime prior to the 2160s.
The Swarm species vessel was a vessel used by the Swarm species to protect their space from foreign vessels.
The Sydney class was a class of relatively large personnel transport ship utilized by the Federation from the late 23rd century through as late as 2375. (; )

"Synth ships" were a type of Starfleet starship in the late 24th century. They were armed with at least one phaser array and torpedo launcher, and featured a large white Starfleet insignia on their ventral and dorsal hull.
A T'Lani cruiser was a type of starship utilized by the T'Lani during the late 24th century. This class of vessel greatly outmatched Starfleet's runabout in speed, firepower and defenses.
The T'Pau-type was a design of Ni'Var starship in use in the late 32nd century. It featured an arrow-shaped primary hull within a ring-shaped warp nacelle, common to Vulcan starship design.
The T'Plana type was a class of small starship first used by the Vulcans during the mid-23rd century for both private and official business. They remained in service through the late 24th century.
The T'Plana-Hath type was a type of warp-capable Vulcan starship in service between the mid-21st and 23rd century.
The tactical flyer was a type of small attack fighter used by Starfleet. It was armed with phasers.
The Tak Tak starship was a type of starship in use by the Tak Tak during the late-24th century. Their weapons systems included torpedoes.
The Takayama-type shuttlecraft was a shuttlecraft type in use by Starfleet in the late 2250s and early 2260s. (; )
The Takret starship was a type of warp-capable vessel used by the Takret in the 22nd century. It was probably capable of at least warp 7.
The Talarian freighter was a type of freighter used by the Talarians during the 24th century.
Talarian observation craft were a type of observation craft used by the Talarians during the mid-24th century for basic training. These ships could be operated with a crew of five.
The Talarian warship was a type of warship used by the Talarians during the mid-24th century.
A Talavian freighter was a cargo vessel of Talavian design.
A Talaxian freighter was a type of freighter operated by the Talaxians.
A Talaxian garbage scow was a type of garbage scow used by the Talaxians for transporting waste products.
The Talaxian ship was a type of small spaceship used by the Talaxians. It was equipped with torpedo tubes and shields. It could carry over 500 passengers, albeit with no room for anything else.
The Tamarian deep space cruiser was an advanced starship-cruiser design utilized by the Tamarians in the 24th century.
Tandaran patrol ships were a type of patrol ship utilized by the Tandarans during the mid-22nd century.
The Tandaran transport was a type of transport vessel in use by the Tandarans in the mid-22nd century.

Tarellian starships (also referred to as Tarellian plague ships) were vessels used as late as the 2360s to carry Tarellian refugees, following the Tarellian Civil War. These ships were equipped with warp drive and transporter technology.
The Taresian starship was a type of patrol ship used by the Taresians in 2373.
Tarkalean freighters were starships utilized by the Tarkaleans during the 22nd century. They had two decks and carried at least twenty-two crewmembers.
Tarkalean vessels were starships utilized during the early 22nd century.
A Teldarian cruiser was a type of cruiser in service during the mid-24th century.

The Tellarite cruiser was a class of cruiser utilized by the Tellarites during the mid-22nd century. These vessels were also utilized as Tellar sleeper ships, in which capacity some continued to function into the 24th century. ()

A Tellarite escape pod was a type of one-occupant emergency vessel-escape vehicle used by the Tellarites aboard their cruisers during the 22nd century. Escape pods aboard surviving sleeper ships remained functional through the 24th century.
Tellarite freighters were the backbone of the Tellarite Mining Consortium during the 22nd century.
The Tellarite merchant ship was a warp-capable type of 23rd century Tellarite freighter that included Tevrin Krit's D-756. ()
Tellarite ships were vessels used by the Tellarites during the mid-23rd century, for questionable, possibly illegal mining operations, on Coridan.
The Tellarite shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft used by the Tellarites in the mid-22nd century. It was capable of landing on a planet's surface, and had numerous armaments.
A Tellarite transport was a type of Tellarite starship utilized in the first half of the 22nd century used to transport passengers.
The Telsian freighter was a type of cargo ship in use by the Telsians in the late-24th century.

A Terellian cargo freighter was a type of cargo freighter utilized by the Terellians during the 24th century. To the trained eye, they could be readily identified by their interior design. The cargo module utilized rechargeable power cells to function. They also carried a large supply of microfusion flares.
A Terran fighter was a type of medium-sized craft used by the Terran Resistance Forces in the mirror universe against the Klingon-Cardassian Alliance during the 2370s.

The Terran raider was a type of small craft used during the late 24th century by the Terran Resistance Forces in the mirror universe against the Klingon-Cardassian Alliance, who referred to the vessel as a Rebel raider.
The Tesnian escape pod was a small Tesnian craft used to evacuate a ship in an emergency. Tesnian starships were equipped with this type of escape pods.
The Tesnian starship was a type of ship in use by the Tesnians in the mid-22nd century. They were equipped with escape pods and had a typical crew complement of 34.

The Texas class was a type of Federation starship briefly operated by Starfleet in the late 24th century. Commissioned by Vice Admiral Les Buenamigo in a misguided effort to compete with other Starfleet flag officers, it was the organization's first fully automated starship. All three vessels of the class malfunctioned and became unhinged due to faulty artificial intelligence, resulting in Buenamigo's death when he lost control of the and a subsequent attack on Douglas Station that ultimately led to the deranged vessels being destroyed by vessels of the .
The Thasian ship was a space-faring vessel utilized by the non-corporeal Thasians. Apparently energy-based, the ship took on the appearance of an indistinct, green mass of light.
The Theta-class raider was a type of starship used by the Miradorn during the 2360s and 70s.

The "Think Tank" vessel was a type of starship operated by the "Think Tank", described by Kurros as being a "modest vessel". In reality, this vessel was incredibly advanced, as it was composed of a neutronium-based alloy that made it very resilient. The vessel spent most of its time hidden in subspace. Because of this, most vessels could not detect or attack it; the only indication of its presence was a brief subspace flux before it entered normal space. The vessel's offensive systems were impressive as well; the directed energy weapons (sixteen weapon hardpoints in all) were able to target and fire on multiple vessels at once.
A Tholian freighter was a type of freighter used by the Tholians in the 2370s.

Tholian ships were small starships of characteristic shape, utilized by the Tholian Assembly during the 23rd century. These vessels were armed with plasma torpedo-like weaponry. But their most powerful weapon was the so-called "Tholian web". This web was "woven" by two or more Tholian vessels around an enemy ship. This web could be used as a high power immobilization field/tractor beam to pull captured starships back to Tholian territory. ()

classes.cr: Could be operated by a single individual

classes.intro: A Tholian vessel was a type of starship employed by the Tholians during the mid-24th century.
A time-pod was a small vessel originating from the 26th century, which had the ability to travel through time.

The Titan II was an American Human-rated expendable rocket that was in service with NASA and the United States Air Force in the mid-20th century. The rocket was used for national defense and space exploration.
The Titan raider was a class of spacecraft used by the Humans from Titan for dilithium raids on Earth in the late 32nd century.
The Titan ship was a spacecraft sent from Titan in the late 32nd century.
The Toron class was a type of small Klingon shuttle in service during the mid-24th century. It could be piloted by a single person.
A Trabalian freighter was a starship employed in the Delta Quadrant during the 24th century.

The transport pod was a type of spacecraft that allowed a single individual from the Sphere-Builders' trans-dimensional realm to be monitored in terraformed sections of the Delphic Expanse. The pod was believed to allow an individual's bio-signs to be recorded to gauge the effectiveness of the Sphere-Builder's terraforming of the Delphic Expanse, as numerous electrodes were hooked up to a test subject.
The Augment transport shuttle was a type of small shuttlecraft used during the 22nd century. Capable of being piloted by as few as two crew, this type of vessel was unarmed.

Tret's containment vessel was a class of starship utilized by Tret's species to prevent any individual infected from the Loque'eque mutagenic virus from leaving the Loque'eque homeworld and infecting neighboring star systems. This class of vessel was armed with dual forward particle cannons, and were capable of exceeding warp 4. During the 2150s, a vessel of this class was commanded by Tret.
The Triannon vessel was a type of starship class used by the Triannon species in the mid-22nd century.
The Turei vessel was a type of starship in use by the Turei in the late-24th century. These ships were heavily armed with plasma charge weapons.
A Tygarian freighter was a freighter used by the Tygarians in the 2370s.
The Type 11 was a shuttlecraft type used by Starfleet in the latter half of the 24th century.
The Type 14 shuttlecraft was a type of Federation shuttle operated by Starfleet in the early 25th century.

classes.cr: Configurations for 1 or 2 pilots, plus at least 1 passenger
classes.intro: The Type 15 shuttlepod was a Federation shuttlepod carried by Starfleet vessels, a more compact version of a standard shuttlecraft.
The Type 18 shuttlepod was a type of Federation Starfleet warp-capable shuttlecraft.
The Type 6 shuttlecraft was a short-range Starfleet auxiliary vehicle carried aboard Federation starships and space stations during the 24th century. ()
The Type 6A captain's yacht was the type of captain's yacht assigned to starships.

The Type 6A shuttlecraft was a warp-capable Federation shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet during the late 24th century. At least five were assigned to the , while the and the were each assigned at least three.
The Type 7 shuttlecraft was a type of Starfleet shuttlecraft carried on board Federation starships during the 24th century.
The Type 8 shuttlecraft was a type of Federation-designed auxiliary space vessel utilized for short term missions.
Tzenkethi raider was a type of starship utilized by the Tzenkethi during their war against the Federation.
The Tzenkethi warship was a class of starship used by the Tzenkethi.
The UFP-02-type was a class of shuttlecraft used by Starfleet in the late 32nd century. ()
Ulis' starship was a starship utilized during the mid-22nd century. In the early 2150s, this ship was owned by the Ferengi merchant Ulis.
The Universe-class was a type of Federation starship in use in one possible version of the 26th century.
The V'draysh escape pod was a type of emergency vessel-escape vehicle used by the V'draysh sometime in the far future.
The Vaadwaur assault fighter was a small assault vessel used by the Vaadwaur in the 15th century. It was capable of operation both in an atmosphere and in space, and was armed with particle cannons.
This "Vaadwaur ship", as so described by Lieutenant Commander Tuvok, was the first vessel encountered by the starship in 2377, after Voyager was accidentally pulled into .
The Vahklas-type was a class of Vulcan starship utilized during the mid-22nd century.

A Valakian shuttle was a small, pre-warp vessel used by the Valakians. In 2150, the Valakians launched four of these vessels to search for a cure for their plague by seeking help from more advanced species. The shuttle had propulsion modules located on the flanks of the hull above the wings, tapering inward towards the rear.
The Valdore type was a Romulan warbird design active in the 24th century.
A Valerian transport was a type of transport starship used by the Valerians in the 24th century.
A Valtese ship was a type of starship utilized by the Valtese during the latter half of the 24th century.
A Vanoben transport was a type of transport starship used during the 24th century.

A Varro generational ship was a starship operated by the Varro, first launched in the 1970s. The ship was equipped with fourteen warp reactors. During Voyager's encounter with the Varro, the Starfleet crew provided engineering assistance, including repair of the Varro's warp injectors. Rather than being a single ship in a large fleet, the vessel was comprised of many individual pods, which collectively housed several generations of Varro people. ()
The Venatic class was a type of hunting starship employed by the Hirogen during 2370s.

The Vidiian warship was a type of warship utilized by the Vidiians during the 2370s. The ship was described as being "loaded with weaponry," including phasers, and could easily outrun and outgun a Federation Type 6 shuttlecraft. ()
Vissian starships were advanced craft employed by the Vissians during the mid-22nd century.

The Vissian stratopod was a small two-person shuttlepod, utilized by the Vissians, equipped with a large round viewport at the . A stratopod carried twice the deflector shielding of the larger Vissian starships, and its navigation control was based on five spatial axes.
The Vor'cha-class attack cruiser was one of the largest and most powerful mainstays of the Klingon Defense Forces during the mid- to late-24th century.

Vorok's battle cruiser was a type of 22nd century Klingon battle cruiser that was in service during the early 2150s, under the command of Klingon Captain Vorok. The vessel was armed with forward and aft torpedo launchers, as well as an aft tractor beam.
The Voth city ship was a massive transwarp-capable starship that served as the center of the Voth civilization.
The Voth research vessel was a type of starship used by the Voth for scientific research in the late-24th century. They were equipped with transwarp drives.

The Vulcan shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft or transport used by the Vulcans in the early 2150s. They were about two decks high, and had a warp-ring drive, similar to most Vulcan combat cruisers of the time.
A Vulcan survey ship was a type of survey ship utilized by the Vulcan High Command from the mid-20th through the mid-22nd centuries.
The Wadi ship was a starship used by the Wadi in the 24th century.
The Walker class was a type of Federation starship in service during the mid-23rd century.
The Wallenberg-class starship was a large type of transport/tug active in the late 24th century. They were used by the Federation Starfleet, and were described as warp-capable ferries.
The Wanderer class was a class V blockade runner utilized by the Orions prior to or during the 2360s.

The waverider was an atmospheric shuttlecraft in service aboard Federation starships. Unlike other auxiliary craft, the waverider was not stowed in a shuttlebay, but was instead docked to the ventral side of the primary hull, just forward of the ship's primary navigational deflector. ()
The Wells class was a timeship used by Starfleet in the 29th century to protect the timeline against temporal incursions.
The Whorfin class was a type of transport starship used by the El-Aurians in the late 23rd century. The class used YPS pulse fusion propulsion system, and had a maximum warp speed of warp factor 4.
Winston's trading vessel was a small one-man civilian starship registered to Carter Winston, a Federation space trader.

The wisp ship was a starship inhabited by non-corporeal beings who were described as "wisps" by the crew of . Although the wisps who inhabited the ship were said to live in subspace, they relied on the ship so as to not be exposed to normal space, which they could not normally inhabit.

The workbee, also known as a cargo management unit or extricator, was a small utility spacecraft used by the Federation from the late 23rd and 24th centuries. It was an apparent successor to the worker bee from the 2250s.

A worker bee or CMU was a small auxiliary craft used by the Federation from the mid-23rd century to the late 24th century. Both the and her contemporary starship the carried a complement of worker bees.
The Wysanti starship was a type of warp-capable ship utilized by the Wysanti, who employed them in the Delta Quadrant during the late 24th century.
The X-15 was an American rocket plane of the mid-20th century. It was used jointly by NASA and the United States Air Force.
A Xantoras patrol ship was a type patrol ship utilized by the Xantoras military during the 2150s.
A Xarantine ship was a type of starship operated by the Xarantine during the 22nd century.

A Xepolite Free Trader was a type of starship utilized by the Xepolites during the late 24th century for hauling freight. These ships were built especially for weapons smuggling, notably for the Cardassians, as they had hulls that were composed of a sensor-reflective material that prevented scanning and were capable of the maximum speed of warp 9.8.
A Xindi cruiser was a type of cruiser employed by the Xindi during the 22nd century
The Xindi launch platform was a small Xindi structure used to house the prototypes of the Xindi weapon prior to deployment.

The Xindi shuttle was a small shuttlecraft used by the Xindi-Primates during the mid-22nd century. The vessel had a cockpit, and three adjustable landing legs that were positioned in a triangular layout, with two smaller struts at the rear, and the third extension being longer and positioned slightly forward of the others.
In 2152, a Xindi starship was attacked by an Osaarian merchant ship, two weeks prior to the 's encounter with the Osaarians.

The Xindi-Aquatic cruiser was a type of starship used by the Xindi-Aquatics during the 22nd century. The vessel was at least 1,800 meters long, heavily armed, and equipped with the most advanced technology of any of the five Xindi species. The ship featured a hydrodynamic, swept-wing hull structure and a large hangar bay in the primary section that could be used to carry other starships. Despite also having superior weaponry, the Xindi-Aquatic ships had a drawback of being slower than other Xindi ships.

The Xindi-Aquatic escape pod was a type of small one-man escape pod of fairly typical design used aboard Xindi-Aquatic cruisers. This type of vessel was had no armaments, and was capable of maneuvering under water.
The Xindi-Aquatic scout ship was a Xindi-Aquatic starship used in the 2150s. It was much faster and more maneuverable then the Aquatics' main cruiser.
The Xindi-Arboreal landing craft was a class of shuttle utilized by the Xindi-Arboreals during the mid-22nd century.
The Xindi-Arboreal starship was a type of starship utilized by the Xindi-Arboreals during the 2150s.

The Xindi-Insectoid assault shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft-sized two-person assault vehicle carried aboard Xindi-Insectoid starships. It was armed with a half dozen particle cannons and torpedo launchers. Much of its power was routed to structural integrity, allowing it to operate in the atmosphere of a gas giant or underwater.

The Xindi-Insectoid patrol ship was a small warp-capable starship utilized by the Xindi-Insectoids during the mid-22nd century. They were armed with at least one forward and one underbelly directed energy weapon emitters.
The Xindi-Insectoid scout ship was a type of warp-capable scout ship used by the Xindi-Insectoids. The vessel was much smaller than most Xindi ships, and only carried a crew of three.
The Xindi-Insectoid ship was a type of warship used by the aggressive Xindi-Insectoids in the 2150s.
The Xindi-Primate starship was a type of Xindi cruiser used by the Xindi-Primates in the 2150s.
The Xindi-Reptilian warship was a large warship utilized by the Xindi-Reptilians during the mid-22nd century. They were capable of maintaining operations with a crew of twenty-two. ()
Xyrillian ships were utilized by the Xyrillians during the mid-22nd century.
The Y-class freighter was a type of starship utilized by the Earth Cargo Service during the 22nd century.
The Y-500 class freighter was a vessel that was used during the 21st century. It was equipped with life pods. Y-500 class freighters were in service by 2088 and retired several decades prior to 2151.
The Yeager type was a type of Federation starship in use during the 2370s.
A Yelikan transport was a type of transport in operation during the late 24th century.

In an alternate timeline, the Yellowstone-class runabout was an upgraded design of the runabout designed in the late-24th century. The Yellowstone-class was designed for a variety of mission profiles.

Yosemite-class was the original intended starship class designation of the , as it was listed in an okudagram in , before a later version of the graphic listed the Trieste as a starship. While the Trieste or any other ship of the Yosemite- or Merced-class has never made an on-screen appearance, confirms that Merced-class was the final and correct class designation of the Trieste.
Yost's ship was a starship assigned to Renovation Team Nova under the command of Supervisor Yost in the late 24th century in the Delta Quadrant.
A Yridian ship was a type of convoy vessel used by the Yridians.
The Yridian shuttle was a shuttlecraft-sized vessel utilized by the Yridians during the 2360s. Such a vessel was capable of traveling at warp speeds, and performing planetary landings.
The Yridian starship was a starship type used by the Yridians during the late 24th century as a destroyer and a freighter.
The Yridian vessel was a type of small shuttlecraft in use with the Yridians during the 2160s. It was capable of being operated by a single individual.
A Zahl starship was a type of space vehicle operated in the Delta Quadrant in the late 24th century by the Zahl species.

The Zalkonian escape pod was a small craft designed for safe escape from Zalkonian vessels in case of emergency. Part of the computer system of the Zalkonian escape pod consisted of small gel-filled capsules.
The Zalkonian warship was a type of advanced warship utilized by the Zalkonians during the mid-24th century.
A Zeon spacecraft was a type of pre-warp spacecraft utilized by the Zeon of planet .

The Zibalian escape pod was a small Zibalian craft used aboard Zibalian freighters for use during an emergency. They were berthed in the back of the ship's cargo bay and required two individuals to initiate the escape sequence.

Zobral's ship was a small, warp-capable starship owned by Zobral during the mid-22nd century. Sleek and wedge-shaped, it could penetrate narrow gaps in the planetary defense system on without being detected.
The etlh class was a type of warship used by the Klingon Empire during the mid-23rd century.
The Academy-class was a type of Federation starship in service during the 32nd century. ()
The Annari warship was a vessel designed for armed conflict used by the Annari in the early 2370s.
A class of Annari warship was utilized by the Annari in the late 2370s.
The Antares-class freighter was an old-style warp-capable freighter utilized by the Corvallens during the 24th century.
The Antares type was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 32nd century. This class was notable for having four nacelles.

Ardra's ship was a starship active in the 24th century that was utilized by a con artist posing as Ardra. The ship functioned as 's base of operations during her many ruses throughout the sector. It was manned by a crew.

The Areore ship was a type of large starship used by the ancient Areore in their interstellar wars. It was similar in design to the more common smaller Areore ship, and armed with a more powerful version of its energy weapon. The ship could land on a planetary surface.

The Areore ship was a type of small starship used by the ancient Areore in their interstellar wars. It was equipped with deflector shields and potent energy weapons of a design unknown to the Federation in the 24th century.
A Bajoran interplanetary shuttle was a type of shuttlecraft used by Bajorans for traveling between destinations in the Bajor system in the 24th century.
The Batlh class was a type of warship used by the Klingon Empire during the mid-23rd century.
The Bavali Station type escape pod was a type of escape pod used by Starfleet aboard space stations such as Bavali Station during the mid-23rd century.
The Beagle-type was an early Earth starship from a parallel universe used for exploring different quantum realities, rather than the galaxy.
The Bellerophon class was a class of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 23rd century. ()
The Breen dreadnought was a class of dreadnought operated by the Breen Imperium during the 32nd century. Massive in size, it was the most powerful vessel in the Breen fleet.

The Breen fighter was a small warp-capable warship used by the Breen Imperium as a fighter and scout ship during the late 32nd century. It was equipped with directed energy weapons and a cloaking device.
A Bynar ship was a type of starship operated by the Bynars during the early 2380s.
The Centaur class was a Federation starship design operated by Starfleet during the 24th century.

The Constitution-class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 31st century and into the 33rd century. Like its predecessor Constitution-classes, it featured a saucer section and secondary hull with two warp nacelles connected by pylons.
The Constitution-class was launched by Starfleet in the latter half of the 23rd century in the . The Constitution-class was in the of starships. ()
The Constitution-type escape pod was a type of escape pod used aboard starships.
The Constitution-type escape pod was a type of escape pod used aboard starships.
The Credence class was a Federation starship design operated by Starfleet during the late 32nd century. Ships of this class had a dual-layered saucer section with multiple warp nacelles.
The Curry class Federation starship was in service during the Dominion War. ()
A customs vessel was a spacecraft used to enforce customs laws.

The Cytherian probe was a type of space probe built by the Cytherians to seek out other species and bring them to their homeworld. The probe was able to move at impulse and warp velocities without emitting particles or generating a subspace field, indicating its propulsion technology to be utterly alien to the Federation. It was highly resistant to phasers but could be destroyed by a number of maximum-yield photon torpedoes.
The D'Var type was a type of scout ship utilized by the Orions during the mid-23rd century. It was also identified as a science vessel.
This D7-class Klingon battle cruiser and prison barge was used during the Federation-Klingon War of 2256-57. ()
The DaSpu class was a type of warship used by the Klingon Empire during the mid-23rd century.

The Dauntless-type was a starship built and operated by Species 116 during the late 24th century. In 2374, a ship of this type was disguised as a "Dauntless-class" experimental Starfleet vessel, sent to the Delta Quadrant to bring the crew of the USS Voyager home sooner, however, was created with the nefarious intent to trap the crew for eventual assimilation at the hands of the Borg. ()
The Deimos class was a type of Federation starship utilized by Section 31 during the 2250s.

The Delphic Expanse spheres were a series of artificially-created spherical objects that were scattered around the Delphic Expanse. The spheres, each one nineteen kilometers in diameter, generated massive amounts of gravimetric energy and were collectively responsible for the web of spatial anomalies which constituted the Expanse. Each sphere was surrounded by a cloaking barrier which kept it hidden from outside observers. According to the Xindi-Primate Degra, the Xindi knew of seventy-eight spheres, at last count. ()
The Dol'drm colony ship was a type of spacecraft used by the Dol'drm to colonize other planets 65 million years ago. The ship was powered by iridium fuel pods and held its crew within cryobeds.
The Dragon 2 was a space capsule built and operated by the aerospace business SpaceX. This spacecraft was launched into space by the Falcon 9 rocket.

This Earth vessel was a small craft was first encountered by in 2152. The craft was approximately six meters long, but, due to the advanced application of an unknown spatial phenomenon, was actually bigger on the inside than on the outside.
The Executive class was a class of shuttlecraft used by Starfleet in the 23rd and 24th centuries. This shuttle class was known to be used for orbital personnel transport. (; )
The Federation shuttlecraft was a shuttlecraft type in use by Starfleet in 2385.
Multiple concept sketches of Federation shuttles designed for can be seen at Trekcore.

The Federation transport container was a type of Federation spacecraft used by Starfleet in the 23rd and 24th centuries for transporting people and cargo. There were several variants of transport containers.

The Galaxy-class starship was a class of Starfleet vessel mentioned in the Treaty of Armens from 2255. It was stated in the treaty, that a UFP official from the Cultural Contact Office (Sol Sector) shall be on board a Galaxy-class Starfleet vessel at all times except during legal holidays.
Gem's starship was a small multi-deck Ferengi starship operated by .
A geoterraforming vessel was a type of starship.
The Gorn attack ship was a type of attack ship employed by the Gorn Hegemony during the 23rd century.
The Gorn hunter ship was a type of small warship employed by the Gorn Hegemony during the 23rd century.
Goroth's starship-type was a transport ship utilized by the Klingon Empire from at least the 2150's through the 2380's.
The Gral-class was a class of starship operated by Starfleet during the mid-23rd century, named for the 22nd century Tellarite diplomat Gral. ()
The Helios class was a type of tug used by the Federation Starfleet during the 23rd and 24th centuries. They were equipped with tractor beams for towing starships.
The Hou-Yi class was a type of Federation starship utilized by Section 31 during the 2250s.
The insectoid starship was a derelict starship discovered by the during a 2269 starcharting mission. Once operated by ancient insectoids, it was not a recorded galactic starship design. ()
The Jein class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the early 25th century.
The Ju'day class was a type of raider that was used in the late 24th century.
The Kelcie Mae type was a Federation starship type operated by Starfleet during the mid-23rd century.
The Ketha class was a type of battle cruiser used by the Klingon diaspora during the 32nd century.

The Klingon escape pod was a type of emergency escape craft installed aboard warships in the Klingon Imperial Fleet during the mid-22nd century. Some Klingon vessel types, such as the scout ships, were not equipped with escape pods. ()
A Klingon heavy cargo carrier was a cargo carrier design used by the Klingon Empire in the 32nd century.
The Lamarr class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet as a "special-class science vessel" during the late 24th century. ()
The Loknar class was a type of starship operated by Starfleet.
The Lutani scout ship was a type of one-person scout ship employed by the Lutani during the mid-23rd century. It was armed with directed energy weapons.
The Lutani warship was a type of military vessel employed by the Lutani during the mid-23rd century.
A Magellan probe was a type of space probe used in the .

The Mark II Nova Flyer was a training vessel used by Nova Squadron during the 2380s. It was redesigned at some point by Lieutenant Tom Paris. Federation crews referred to them as "shuttles", while the Vau N'Akat referred to them as "enemy fighters". ()

This Martian ship, also called Martian warship or Martian vessel; was a warship used by the Martians. It was equipped with technology that was similar to a tractor beam that was described as "energy tendril" known as tethers. They were useful for salvaging ships for their war efforts against the Dol'drm.
The Mat'Aaran ship was a type of spacecraft used by the Mat'Aarans in the 23rd century.

The Merchantman-type of spacecraft was a highly modifiable, upgradeable, and versatile vessel used in the Alpha Quadrant, Beta Quadrant, and Delta Quadrant by governments, military, and civilians. All ships of this type had the same basic configuration; however, there were variations in the size of the ships, with some being considerably larger than others. These ships were either warp powered or impulse powered and were equipped with lasers or phasers. The crew complement aboard these ships could be as low as two and as high as 78.

The Mercury capsule was a type of American space capsule operated by NASA for its Project Mercury from 1961 to 1963. This was the first manned spacecraft of the agency. Each ship was given a name ending with a 7 by their pilots. The capsule was launched into space by the Mercury-Redstone Launch Vehicle.
The NCC-1279 type was a Federation starship in service during the mid-23rd century. ( season 3 and season 4 opening credits; )
The Negh'Var-class was the largest class of cruiser known to operate in the Klingon Empire during the late 24th century.
The Nimrod class was a type of Federation starship utilized by Section 31 during the 2250s.
An orbital platform was a 24th century Federation spacecraft operated by Starfleet. These spacecraft were equipped with life support systems.

The Orion destroyer was a class of warship used by the Orion Syndicate. Also described as a battleship, these vessels were massive in size and mounted considerable firepower, though they were considered antiquated by the late 24th century.
The Orion medical frigate was a type of medical ship employed by the Orions in the 21st century. Such vessels were used to cure the Great Plague.
The Qaw class was a type of warship used by the Klingon Empire during the mid-23rd century.
The QeHpu class was a type of battle cruiser used by the Klingon diaspora during the 32nd century.
The Qoj class was a type of battle cruiser used by the Klingon Empire during the mid-23rd century. It was similar to, but shorter than the .
The RM-2 was a design of civilian cargo vessel, considered antiquated by the mid-23rd century. It was rather slow, with a speed described as "barely above sublight."
A racing ship was a type of starship built to compete in races.
The Razor was a class of small starship used by the inhabitants of Ni'Var in the late 32nd century.
A rescue shuttle was a specialized shuttle used by Starfleet for evacuating the starships.
The Rev-1 type was a class of Vau N'Akat starship, intended by Asencia for waging war of annihilation against the Federation in 2385. ()
The Rodaxian starship was a type of warp-capable spacecraft used by the Rodaxians during the mid-23rd century.
The Rogue Changeling starship was a type of starship utilized by rogue Changelings affiliated with Vadic in early 2401.
The Praetor's flagship was a type of warship that was in service with the military of the Romulan Star Empire during the latter half of the 23rd century under personal command of the Romulan Praetor.
The Romulan warbird was a type of warbird operated by the Romulan military in the 2340s. They were known to be less maneuverable than Starfleet's starships.
The Romulan starship was a type of starship used by the Romulan Free State and the Tal Shiar during the late 24th century.
The Sabrerunner class was a class of Federation starship that was in service with Starfleet during the latter half of the 24th century.
The Sacagawea type shuttlecraft was a type of shuttlecraft used by Starfleet in the 2380s.

The Scimitar was a massive, heavily-armed Reman warbird. It was constructed under the command of Shinzon as part of a secret plot to overthrow the Romulan Senate, defeat the United Federation of Planets, and liberate the subjugated natives of Remus.
The Section 31 shuttle was a class of auxillary vessel in use by Section 31 in the 23rd century.
The following is a list of Section 31 starships.
The Shangri-La class was a type of starship operated by Starfleet.
A ship class was a shared construction design of spacecraft or starship operated by an entity.
The Shiva class was a type of Federation starship utilized by Section 31 during the 2250s.
The Shrike was a formidable starship commanded by the Changeling Vadic. The ship was named after the , a small carrion bird from Earth. ()

In starship classification, a shuttlecraft, shuttle, or glider was a type of auxiliary space vessel typically attached to a starship or a starbase. Most shuttles were short-range transports, possessing only impulse drive or a limited warp capability. Utilization of shuttlecraft was common for most spacefaring civilizations, and along with the transporter, were two of the more common conventional modes of transportation to and from one place to another. () Shuttles were generally used for landings when transporters were inoperable, or not yet within the technological capabilities of a species. At times shuttlecraft were used by individuals who preferred not to use transporters or were unable
A shuttlepod was a type of shuttlecraft operated by Starfleet in the 2150s and early 2160s. The shuttlepods were used to transport personnel to and from planets and/or spacecraft.
The soliton wave rider was an unmanned test ship used during the mid-24th century.
A sphinx workpod was a type of auxiliary craft that was used during the 24th century.
The Starfleet Six-type was a class of shuttlecraft used by Starfleet in the late 32nd century.
A Talaxian ship was a type of starship utilized by the Talaxians in the 2360s.

The Talaxian ship was a type of small starship used by the Talaxians to defend their colonies. The ship was armed with a bow-mounted directed energy weapon and protected by shields, though it lacked transporter capability.
A taxicab (also, taxi and/or cab) was a form of public transport vehicle in which patrons paid to be taken to requested destinations. An operator of a taxicab was called a taxi driver.
The Tellarite freighter was a type of freighter used by the Tellarites during the 20th century.
Tellarite freighters were a type of freighter used by the Tellarites during the 24th century.

The Teracaq type was a type of Torothan prison shuttle in service in the late 32nd century. Piloted by a single pilot, the vessel could hold at least two guards and one prisoner, with room for more. ()

classes.intro: The Tholian starship of the 22nd century was a relatively small starship employed by the Tholian Assembly.
The Thorn type was a class of Federation starship used by Starfleet during the 23rd century. It was equipped with a tractor beam capable of towing a vessel. ()

A travel pod was a small Federation shuttle predominately used during the 23rd century by facilities like the orbital office complex and Spacedock One to transfer personnel to drydocks or spaceships without having to use transporters. (, et al.)

A travel pod was a small Federation shuttle predominately used during the 25th century by facilities like Sol Station to transfer personnel to drydocks or spaceships without having to use transporters. ()
A Trill transport was a type of transport vessel utilized by the Trill during the mid-24th century.
A Trill transport was a type of transport vessel utilized by the Trill during the mid-24th century.
The Type 10 shuttlepod was a shuttlepod design used by the Federation Starfleet. This class of shuttlepod was carried aboard the starships in the late-24th century.
The Type 17 shuttlecraft was a type of Federation shuttle operated by Starfleet in the late 24th century. This shuttlecraft type was assigned to starships. ()
The Type 4 shuttlecraft was a shuttlecraft type operated by Starfleet in the 23rd century.
The Type 6C shuttlecraft was a type of Federation Starfleet warp-capable shuttlecraft.
The United Earth Defense Force ship was a class of spacecraft used by the United Earth Defense Force for defending Earth during the late 32nd century.

This type of starship was used by Starfleet during the mid-22nd century. The primary hull was triangular in shape, and had two nacelles mounted port and starboard angled upward from and slightly above the hull.

The Vau N'Akat ship was a type of small vessel used by the Vau N'Akat in the late 24th century during the Vau N'Akat Civil War.
The Venari Ral ship was a type of warship operated by the Venari Ral in the late 32nd century.
The veqlargh class was a type of warship used by the Klingon Empire during the mid-23rd century.

The Vidiian ship was a type of starship utilized by the Vidiian Sodality during the late 24th century. This class of vessel could be operated by a crew of two, and was evenly matched for speed with an starship.

The Vidiian ship was a massive starship utilized by the Vidiians in 2371 and 2372. This class of vessel operated with a crew of well over three hundred, and was armed with hyper-thermic charges and grapplers, which was used to access captured ships.
Vrek's starship was a Romulan starship operated by the Romulan military in the late 24th century. The ship was equipped with a cloaking device, disruptors, and shields.

This Vulcan cruiser was a type of Vulcan starship that was commissioned sometime after 2152. It shared a similar design lineage with the , but instead of a single "hoop" warp nacelle, it contained three rings arranged in a clover-shaped arrangement.
The Wanderer-class was a class of starship.
A warp pod was a small warp-capable spacecraft utilized by the Terran Empire. It could hold at least two people.
The workpod was a small utility spacecraft utilized by the Federation in the late 24th century.

Yonada was a ten thousand-year-old asteroid ship, built by the Fabrini when they realized that their home sun was about to go supernova and completely destroy their solar system. Yonada was constructed to look like an asteroid and was sent on a computer-controlled course to a habitable colony world. The ship measured two hundred miles (320 kilometers) in diameter. Chemically, it was a typical asteroid; however, it was self-propelled by atomic power and could correct for gravitational stresses. The engines left behind a trail of debris and hard radiation. The ship could defend itself with chemically-fueled missiles.

ships.intro: 042 was a Federation worker bee that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to the Federation starship Discovery. ()

208 was the registry number of an emergency evac jumpship in service to Starfleet in London, on Earth, in 2259. At that time, it was reported that 208 had been commandeered by following his bombing of the Kelvin Memorial Archive in London.
313-C was the designation of a Constitution-type escape pod in 2258.
5 was the registry number of a shuttlecraft that was in service in 2381.
Abaddon's space station functioned as the hub of Abaddon's Repository of Lost Treasures. This space station was where Abaddon lived. It also housed his miscellaneous pieces of merchandise. ()
Adonis was a Federation Type 6A shuttlecraft attached to the .

The Aeon was a 29th century Model HB-88 Federation timeship operated by Starfleet. It was capable of traveling through time via generation of temporal rifts. Captain Braxton was the commanding officer of the ship.
The Akritirian maximum security detention facility was a space station used as a prison, operated by the Akritirian government, located somewhere in their space.
The Aldara was a Cardassian cruiser that was in service with the Cardassian military in the mid-24th century. In the late 2360s, the Aldara was under the command of Gul Danar.
The Algonquin was a Federation starship operated by Starfleet during the 24th century.

Alice was the name that Tom Paris gave to an alien shuttlecraft he bought from Abaddon's Repository of Lost Treasures in the Delta Quadrant. The ship's computer contained a program that could manifest itself as a person to its pilot. ()
Alpha Nine was the designation for a ship used by the Maquis in a joint attack of a Yridian convoy in 2370.
Alpha Seven was the designation for a Maquis fighter in 2370.

The Amargosa observatory was a Federation K-7D space station operated by Starfleet in the late 24th century. The observatory was located in orbit of the star Amargosa and was used for scientific research regarding the star. Its coordinates were 917358-358268-102879.
