Explorer S-55 was an artificial satellite, launched by NASA from the United States of America, and orbited Earth during the mid-20th century. An image of this satellite was stored in the library computer of the . This image was later retrieved by the Talosians during their survey of the library computer's contents in 2254. ()

The extra galactic probe was a probe sent to the Milky Way Galaxy from outside the galaxy. Sometime prior to 2364, the encountered the probe. The location of this incident was marked in viewscreen readouts aboard the on several occasions in 2364, in the form of star charts from the Enterprise library computer. ()
The Fairview was a Federation Type 6A shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet in the late 24th century, attached to the . ()

Farpoint Station was a starbase built in an extremely short time on Deneb IV. The Bandi, a species inhabiting Deneb IV, offered this station to Starfleet. The Bandi were not a very advanced civilization and Starfleet was intrigued by this engineering performance.

The Federation Medical Collection Station was an outpost that specialized in medicine. This type of outpost facilitated the retrieval and storage of samples of diseases, including plasma plagues. Because of the sensitive nature of the outpost's work, there were Starfleet personnel who worked at the post under the supervision of a ranking individual known as a medical trustee.
The Ferengi probe was a type of unmanned sensor drone utilized by the Ferengi during the late-24th century.
The Fermi was a Federation Type 6 shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlecraft 16.
The Fesarius was a starship built and operated by the First Federation, encountered in the mid-23rd century. It was described as the flagship by its captain and only crewmember, Commander Balok.
The Feynman was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlecraft 05.
The Feynman was a Federation Type 15 shuttlepod that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlepod 19.
The FGMS Gyt'aerat was a starship that was registered for Federation travel in the late 24th century.
The Fleming was a 24th century Federation starship operated by Starfleet. This medical transport was constructed of such materials as duranium and polycomposites.
The FMS Geldonero was a starship that was registered for Federation travel in the late 24th century.
The Foresight was a Federation civilian emergency transport that was in service in the late 32nd century.
The Free Spirit was a small starship owned and operated by Petra Aberdeen, an independent archaeologist and former Starfleet officer.
Freedom 7 was an American space capsule operated by NASA for its Project Mercury. It was the agency's first manned mission.

Friendship 1 (UESPA-1) was a deep space probe launched by the United Earth Space Probe Agency in 2067 with the purpose of finding other species. The probe contained a great deal of technological, scientific, and cultural information, such as translation matrices, data on computer chips, transceivers, warp drive, and Vivaldi's The Four Seasons. As only four years had passed since first contact, Humanity was keen to find other intelligent lifeforms, but they were aware that the lifeforms they intended to find may be unaware of how to create a means of contacting Humanity, so the probe was equipped to inform any lifeforms on how to design communication arrays.
Funny Face was a Federation Class C shuttle assigned to in the 33rd century. It was the last shuttle received by Discovery before its crew abandoned ship, and had never been flown or named.
The Galileo was a Federation Type 4 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the late 23rd century, attached to the . It was shuttle 5.
The Galileo was a Federation Type 6 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttle 07.

The Galileo was a space probe operated by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) in the late 1990s. This probe was sent to study Jupiter and its many moons, including Europa. Images taken by the probe of this moon revealed "diverse details" of its surface.
The Gallough was a freighter similar to the Federation , in service during the 23rd century. It had been modified to carry passengers.
The Gamma 7 outpost was an outpost in the Alpha Quadrant.
The Gasko was a Romulan starship that was in service for the Romulan Star Empire during the latter half of 24th century.

A Gatherer outpost was a small encampment of Gatherers, the nomadic marauders who hailed from the planet Acamar III. The first of these outposts was established in 2266. Since then, these outposts have moved location, from star system to star system, making them difficult for Acamarians and Starfleet alike to find them. In 2366, a Gatherer outpost was discovered on the planet Gamma Hromi II by the Federation starship .
The Gav'Nor was a 31st century starship destroyed by the Burn circa 3069.
The GCA Metlaok was a starship in active service in the late 2360s.
The GCS Recio was a 24th century starship registered for Federation travel.
The Gedana post was a outpost where Arjin's father was a pilot instructor for forty years during the 24th century. ()
Gelnon's attack ship was a Jem'Hadar attack ship commanded by Gelnon in 2374. Its Jem'Hadar crew included Kudak'Etan, Ixtana'Rax, Lamat'Ukan and Duran'Adar.

Gemini 8 was an early manned mission. This mission was part of NASA's Gemini program. This program was sandwiched between the earlier Mercury and later Apollo programs of manned space flight. One of the milestones of this program was achieved by Gemini 8 on March 16, 1966.
The Genorex was a Romulan warbird that was in service with the Romulan military in the late 24th century.

A geomagnetic compensator was a type of artificial satellite developed by the Alshain to compensate for the shifting of Alshain IV's magnetic poles, which began in the late 29th century and would have otherwise impaired the Alshain's ability to navigate during flight. The satellites used dilithium to stabilize their power supply.
Georgiou's transport was a shuttlecraft used for ferrying Emperor to the in 2255.

The GHD Per'ot was a 24th century starship registered for Federation travel. In 2370, the captain of this ship was R. Philbin. The starship's point of departure was Deneb XX. The starship arrived at Deep Space 9 on stardate 47566.8. The GHD Per'ot was listed on the space station's arrival roster. (, production art)
The Gillespie was a Federation Type 6A shuttlecraft attached to the .
The Gilliam was a Federation shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to the .

The Goddard was a Federation Type 6 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttle number 15, replacing the shuttlecraft Magellan lost in 2368.
The Gorkon was a Federation Type 14 shuttlecraft in service to Starfleet during the early 25th century. It was attached to the .
A gravimetric microprobe was a Starfleet device used aboard Deep Space 9.
A graviton catapult was a unique form of technology, designed by an alien named Tash, that was created to propel a spacecraft across interstellar space.

The Groumall was a freighter that was in service with the Cardassian military in the late 24th century. Gul Dukat was assigned command of the Groumall after he was demoted for bringing his illegitimate daughter, Tora Ziyal, back to Cardassia Prime. Glinn Damar also served on board as the first officer.

GS 12 was a starship that was registered for Federation travel in the late 24th century. In 2370, the captain of this ship was H. Ellison. The starship's point of departure was Organia. The starship arrived at Deep Space 9 on stardate 47557.1. The GS 12 was listed on the space station's arrival roster. (, production art)

The H-46 was the designation of a Sovereign-type escape pod assigned to the . This pod was the first in a chain of pods that ended with H-926 on the port side of the primary hull, aft of the bridge. When leaving the Enterprise-E, this pod and H-48 were the first and second pods to be launched in their chain.

The H-47 was the designation of a Sovereign-type escape pod assigned to the . This pod was located between H-46 and H-926 on the port side of the primary hull, aft of the bridge. When leaving the Enterprise-E, this pod and H-49 were the third and fourth pods to be launched in their chain.

The H-48 was the designation of a Sovereign-type escape pod assigned to the . This pod was located between H-46 and H-926 on the port side of the primary hull, aft of the bridge. When leaving the Enterprise-E, H-46 and this pod were the first and second pods to be launched in their chain.

The H-49 was the designation of a Sovereign-type escape pod assigned to the . This pod was located between H-46 and H-926 on the port side of the primary hull, aft of the bridge. When leaving the Enterprise-E, H-47 and this pod were the third and fourth pods to be launched in their chain.

The H-50 was the designation of a Sovereign-type escape pod assigned to the . This pod was located between H-46 and H-926 on the port side of the primary hull, aft of the bridge. When leaving the Enterprise-E, this pod was the sixth to be launched in its chain.

The H-925 was the designation of a Sovereign-type escape pod assigned to the . This pod was located between H-46 and H-926 on the port side of the primary hull, aft of the bridge. When leaving the Enterprise-E, this pod was the seventh and final to be launched in its chain.

The H-926 was the designation of a Sovereign-type escape pod assigned to the . This pod was the end point of a chain of pods that began with H-46 on the port side of the primary hull, aft of the bridge. When leaving the Enterprise-E, this pod was the fifth to be launched in its chain.
The Haakona was a Romulan warbird that was in service with the Romulan military in the mid-24th century.
The Haru outposts were Cardassian military outposts during the Cardassian Occupation of Bajor.
The Havana was a 24th century Federation starship.
The Hawking was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the .

The Hawking was a Federation Type 6C shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the late 24th century, attached to the . It was the second shuttle named for Stephen Hawking aboard the Enterprise-D, and it was shuttle 15.
The Heinlein was a Federation Type 15 shuttlepod that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlepod number 08.
The Heva VII refueling port was a space station located at Heva VII which provided fuel to spacecraft.
The Hirogen training facility was a space station built by the Hirogen incorporating holographic technology from the Federation starship, .

The "HMS Bounty" was the name given to the Klingon Bird-of-Prey commandeered by James T. Kirk and his command crew in 2285. The name was originally suggested by Dr. Leonard McCoy as an ironic joke, in reference to the famous sea-going vessel of the same name which was taken over by mutineers in the 18th century. The vessel's new name was painted on the hull in large, orange letters. ()
HMS Lord Nelson was a Terran DY-500-B (sub)class starship that was in service in the early 22nd century.
HMS New Zealand was a Terran [[DY-732|DY-732 [N]-class]] starship that was in service in the early 22nd century. New Zealand was under the command of Captain Bob Lederman.
The Horizon was an early Federation starship that was in service during the mid-22nd century.
Hubble Deep Space Station was a deep space station.
Hubble Space Telescope was a manned space telescope.
The Hunhau drone was a small, flying device used by the Emerald Chain at the salvage yard on Hunhau. It had the capability of identifying materials through analysis.
A hydraulic probe was a probe used for terraforming.
The Hypatia was a Federation Type 6 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttle number 03, replacing the shuttlecraft lost in 2370.

An Iconian probe was a spherical blue orb with energy tendrils arcing at random and which was employed by the ancient, powerful, and extinct Iconian race to download an operating system into a ship's computer core, presumably in order to facilitate communication. However, if the operating system of the ship is too different from the Iconian one, they will clash, causing the vessel and its systems to malfunction and possibly suffer catastrophic consequences. Once the ground-based computer detected an incoming vessel into orbit of Iconia, an automated sequence would begin launching one probe per vessel. The probes were housed in a launch bay in the planet's surface. If many were released at on
The Indiana Jones was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlecraft 08.
The Inside Straight was a starship owned by Captain Rupert Crandall.
Interceptor One was the call sign of a Bajoran interceptor in service during the 2370s.

An interface probe was a type of Federation probe designed to be controlled remotely via direct connection to a person's brain and respond to the movements that the person intended to make. The person controlling the probe wore an interface suit which provided tactile sensations in order to feel as if he or she was experiencing the same environment as the probe. The probe was configured with both tractor beams and phasers and transmitted information via a focused particle beam. It could also sense quantum fluctuations and subspace anomalies not perceptible by other types of sensors.

The International Space Station was a space station and one of Earth's first internationally combined efforts in exploring space. The station was jointly serviced by American space shuttle orbiters and Russian Soyuz and Progress spacecraft.
The Intrepid was an United Earth starship that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-22nd century. The ship's motto was "In Mare In Cælo" ("Into the Sea In the Sky").

The Io Facility was a top secret Starfleet Section 31 construction hangar located in orbit of the Jovian moon Io, at coordinates 23.17.46.11 in the Sol system. Shuttlecraft could enter the interior bay of the large enclosed drydock when panel sections on the side of the dock were rotated and moved out of the way. These craft ferried parts for a starship to at least one of twelve loading docks.
The Imperial Romulan Warbird Khazara was a Romulan warbird that was in service with the Romulan military during the mid-24th century.

The ISS Avenger (NX-09) was a battle cruiser that was in service to in the mid-22nd century. Avenger had fought for the Terran Empire in their war against rebels in the 2150s, and was one of several vessels destroyed by the starship during 's power struggle for the throne of the Empire.
The ISS Buran (NCC-1422) was a starship that was in service to in the mid-23rd century. The ship's commanding officer was . ()

The ISS Cerritos was the mirror universe counterpart of the . In comparison to the Prime Cerritos, the ISS Cerritos carried more weaponry, including a pair of prominent weapons pods on top of the saucer, additional phaser banks, and two mission pods on rollbar structure, one above the main saucer and one above the secondary hull.

The ISS Charon was a starship that was in service to the Terran Empire in the mid-23rd century. Its captain was Maddox. Along with serving as the flagship of the Terran fleet, this vessel housed the palace of the Terran emperor, .
The ISS Cooper was a starship that was in service to in the mid-23rd century. The ship's commanding officer was Captain Spoeneman.

The ISS Defiant (NX-74205) was a warship that was in service to the Terran Resistance Forces in the latter half of the 24th century. The Defiant was constructed and launched in 2372 by the Rebellion at , in orbit of the planet . The design of the Defiant was based on specifications of its counterpart the which were "acquired" from Deep Space 9 in 2371. This warship proved of crucial importance in fighting the Klingon-Cardassian Alliance at the Battle of Terok Nor, and represented an important boost to the Terrans' fighting power during the Terran Rebellion.
The ISS Discovery (NCC-1031) was a starship that was in service to in the mid-23rd century.
The ISS Enterprise (NCC-1701) was a battle cruiser that was in service to in the mid-23rd century.
The ISS Enterprise (NX-01) was a battle cruiser that was in service to in the mid-22nd century.
The ISS Shenzhou (NCC-1227) was a starship that was in service to the Terran Empire in the mid-23rd century.
The ITA Elmira was a starship that was registered for Federation travel in the late 24th century.
The Jaradan probe was a long-range probe that was sent by the insect-like Jarada.

The Jellyfish was a late 24th century starship commissioned by the Vulcan Science Academy for the transport of red matter. It was described as being "[their] fastest ship", and featured a rotating tail section.
The JF Kennedy was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlecraft number 15.
The Joshua Tree was a Federation Type 6A shuttlecraft in service to Starfleet in the late 24th century, attached to the .
The Jovis was a Zibalian freighter that was in service in the mid-24th century. This ship was commanded by the unscrupulous trader and collector Kivas Fajo.
Jupiter Outpost 92 was an outpost located in close vicinity of Jupiter.
Jupiter Research Station, also more simply known as Jupiter Station, was a Starfleet research station located in orbit of Jupiter.
The Justman was a Federation Type 6 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttle number 03.
Kalara's escape pod was a type of spacecraft used by Kalara in 2263 of the . It had an extremely angular shape.
Kalara's ship was part of an elaborate ruse that Kalara told members of the Federation, in an attempt to lure the to the planet Altamid, in order for Krall to obtain a piece of the Abronath.
The Kallisko was a warp-capable transport ship active in the 24th century whose home port was on Boreal III. The Kallisko was equipped with minimal shields and low-level particle phasers.
A Kataan probe was an artifact created by the Kataan to preserve memories of their civilization before their extinction in the 14th century.
The Kearsarge was a 24th century Federation starship.
The Kelvas facility was a Cardassian repair facility in the Kelvas system. This facility was in a sector of the Alpha Quadrant.
Shuttle 2 was a Kelvin-type shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet, assigned to the in 2233.
Shuttle 3 was a Kelvin-type shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet, assigned to the in 2233.
Shuttle 43 was a Kelvin-type shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet, assigned to the in 2233.
The Kings Canyon was a Federation Type 6A shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet during the late 24th century, attached to the .
The Kitsilano was a Federation Type 6A shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet in the late 24th century, attached to the . ()
The Koranak was a Cardassian cruiser that was in service with the Obsidian Order in the late 24th century.
The Kornaire was a Cardassian warship that was in service with the Cardassian military in the mid-24th century.
Kosygin Base was an outpost within Federation space in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant. This outpost provided outposts like the Regula I research station with goods.
The Kotoi was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttle number 07.
The Krasner outpost was an outpost that was involved in a military conflict involving the Federation before 2367. This outpost was located somewhere in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant.
The Kraxon was a Cardassian cruiser that was in service with the Cardassian military in the late 24th century. In 2371, the Kraxon was under the command of Gul Ranor.
The Krayton was a Ferengi starship that was in service in the mid-24th century. Krayton was commanded by DaiMon Tog. Among Kraytons crew were Doctors Farek and Nibor.
The Kreechta was a Ferengi marauder that was in service in the mid-24th century. Kreechta was commanded by DaiMon Bractor.
The KSF Khi'eth (971014) was a Kelpien research vessel that was in service during the 31st century. Information on this ship was available though the Federation database.
Kukulkan's probe was a "mysterious alien space probe" that was sent out by Kukulkan. It possessed a highly advanced propulsion system.

The Kumari was an Andorian battle cruiser that was in service with the Andorian Imperial Guard during the mid-22nd century. It was named after the first ice-cutter to circumnavigate Andoria, and was the first starship of her class.
Kynk's shuttle was a Ferengi shuttle owned by Kynk.
The L5 Test Station was an installation associated with the NX Project. Its assignment patch, along with a number of others, was on display in a case at the 602 Club. ()
The Ladyjane was a shuttlecraft owned by Mister .
Laika was a Federation long range shuttle that was in service in the late 23rd century.
The LaSalle was a 24th century Federation starship.
The Ley, or Shuttle 09, was a Federation Type 15 shuttlepod that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the .
The Ligon orbital control station was a space station in orbit of Ligon II which acted as a liaison between starships and the planetary government.
The Lindberg was a Federation Type 15 shuttlepod that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlepod 09.

The long-range impact probe was a type of Federation probe in service in the mid-24th century. This probe was fueled by 0.2 kilogram Blitmanite or Hutzelite 27 charges. This probe would be fired into a celestial body, which would eject underground soil from the impact site. An orbiting ship would then analyzed this soil for its composition. ()
The Loonkerian outpost was an outpost located on the planet Klendth. This outpost was located somewhere in the Alpha or Beta Quadrant.
Lunar One Colony was the largest Human outpost on Luna, Earth's moon, in the 22nd century.
In 2370, Lunar Receiving was listed on the Deep Space 9 arrival roster as the point of departure for the C-57-D. (, production art)
The Lunar V base was a small resistance camp located on Jeraddo.

Lya Station Alpha was a Federation space station orbiting a planet in the Alpha Quadrant, near Merak, Kressari, Tagra, and Capella. It had been in service with Starfleet since at least the mid-23rd century. ()
The Lysian Central Command was a large space station in the Lysian system that served as the headquarters for the Lysian Alliance military.
M-Zed-5, also known as Outpost MZ-5, was an outpost in the Beta Quadrant. ()
The Magellan was a Federation Type 6 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlecraft number 15.

The Makar was a Romulan warbird that was in service with the Tal Shiar in the late 24th century. The Makars cloaking device was modified to prevent detection by Dominion sensors at speeds under warp 6.
The Maldorian station was a space station based in the Delta Quadrant.
Marayna's space station was a space station hidden in an inversion nebula in the Delta Quadrant.

Mariner 2 was an American Mariner program space probe that was in service with NASA in the mid-20th century. A schematic of this spacecraft was stored in the 's library computer database. This database was accessed by the Talosians in 2254.
The Markonian outpost was an outpost located in the Delta Quadrant. A station manager worked on this outpost.
The Marpole was a Federation Type 6A shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet in the late 24th century, attached to the . ()
The Mars Orbital Facility was a space station located in orbit of the planet Mars.

Mars Station was a Federation space station that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century. This facility, in orbit above Mars, was attached to the Utopia Planitia Fleet Yards. In the 2360s, this facility, especially drafting room 5, was actively involved with the work associated with the Starship Development Project.
The McAuliffe was a Federation Type 7 shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . It was shuttlecraft 21.

The McKinley Station, also known as Earth Station McKinley, was a Federation spacedock that was in service with Starfleet in the late 24th century. This docking facility was located in Earth's orbit, and was designed for starship construction, refitting and maintenance layovers. (; )
McNair Starbase was a Federation starbase in service during the 23rd century. The base was located at coordinates 3001.7850.
The medical drone was a type of flying drone used for medical care aboard ships in the late 32nd century.
Medical shuttle 37 was a Kelvin-type shuttlecraft that was in service to Starfleet, assigned to the in 2233.

The Mercantile drone was a type of small flying device used by the personnel of the Mercantile, a marketplace in Requiem, Hima, for various tasks in the 32nd century. A drone had three detached appendages surrounding a central body, which contained a camera. Drones were programmed with the ability of passing through force fields.
The Merchantman was a small civilian freighter in service during the late 23rd century.
A microprobe was a type of small probe carried aboard Federation starships that was used in cases where conventional probes were too large to be effective.
Midos V Satellite City Spaceport was an orbital spaceport at the planet Midos V.
The Milan was a 24th century Federation transport ship.
The space station Mir (Russian for peace), a product of the Russian Space Agency, was a research facility in orbit around Earth in the late 20th century.
The Monaveen was a Hysperian cruiser used by Queen Paolana.
The Mondor was a sub-light Pakled ship that was in service during the mid-24th century, under the command of Grebnedlog; the ship's chief engineer was his friend Reginod.
A monitor post was an unmanned outpost for observations by the Federation.
The Monk was a Federation Type 6A shuttlecraft attached to the .
The Moore was a Federation Moore-type shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century.

A multi-spatial probe was an advanced probe carried by . Apart from incorporating multi-spatial technology, it was equipped with unimatrix shielding designed by Lieutenant Commander Tuvok. Other features were a telemetry link, and the ability to emit a polaron burst.

ships.n: Mutara Interdimensional Deep Space Array System
ships.intro: The Mutara Interdimensional Deep Space Array System, or MIDAS array for short, was a Federation communications array that was in service with Starfleet in the late 24th century. Starfleet worked with Vulcans in deploying this array. The array was also referred to as the Mutara Interdimensional Deep-Space-Transponder Array System by Lieutenant Reginald Barclay of the Pathfinder Project.
The Nanut was a Tygarian freighter that was in service in the late 24th century. Its executive officer in the 2370s was Romah Doek.
NAR-30974 was a Federation dry dock that was in service with Starfleet in the late 23rd century. This facility was located in orbit above Earth.
The Narada was a Romulan mining vessel that was in service in the late 24th century.
The Nausicaan cargo station was a facility built into one side of a small asteroid. It had multiple docking arms for vessels to use.
NC-05 was a United Earth that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-22nd century, attached to Starfleet Command. It had blue and silver streamlines.
NCC-K7 was the registry of a Federation Class F shuttlecraft that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-23rd century, attached to Deep Space Station K-7.

The Nenebek (NAR-21166) was a Nenebek-type sublight mining shuttle that was in service in the independent Pentarus system in the mid-24th century. Constructed sometime in the mid-23rd century, this shuttle was used for ferrying people. Nenebek was the property of Captain Dirgo, who had logged almost 10,000 hours in this shuttle, and had modified the maneuvering thrusters into an unusual configuration.
The Nerada was a Nasari starship that was in service in the late 24th century. This vessel was commanded by Alben.
The New Paris Colony Starbase was a Federation starbase associated with New Paris.
The Ni'Var was a Vulcan combat cruiser that was in service with the Vulcan High Command in the mid-22nd century. The vessel was commanded by Sopek.

The Nightingale was the name given by Ensign Harry Kim to the Kraylor starship Medical Transport 136, previously under the command of Captain Brell. The Nightingale differed from other Kraylor medical transports in that it was used on a secret mission by a research team to transport a cloaking device developed for their fleet.

Nimbus 1 was an American Nimbus Program weather satellite that was in service with NASA in the mid-20th century. This satellite was equipped with high-resolution cameras which were used to photograph the surface of the Earth. An image of the Nimbus 1 satellite in Earth's polar orbit was stored in the library computer of the . This image was later retrieved by the Talosians during their survey of the library computer's contents in 2254.
The Nokaro was a colony ship carrying nearly three thousand people, mostly families.

The Nomad MK-15c (NSSDC ID: 2002-045b) space probe was a Nomad Program spacecraft that was in service in the early 21st century. Dr. Jackson Roykirk designed the probe with two goals in mind: to create a probe that could function as a perfect thinking machine capable of independent logic and that could seek out new lifeforms in interstellar space.
The Norkan outposts were a grouping of outposts in the Norkan system, Beta Quadrant. These outposts were approximately 101 light years from Sol.
The Norkova was a 24th century Federation freighter.
The NSS T'Pau was a starship operated by the Ni'Var Government during the late 32nd century.
NX-Alpha was one of three test vehicles used in Starfleet's NX Project, along with the NX-Beta and the NX-Delta, and the first Human vessel to travel at warp 2 under pilot A.G. Robinson.
The NX-Beta was one of three test vehicles, along with the NX-Alpha and NX-Delta, used by Starfleet's NX Project to test and refine the warp 5 engine designed by Henry Archer.
The NX-Delta was a prototype vessel used in the NX Project in an effort to test and refine Henry Archer's warp 5 engine design.
The Nyran was a Vulcan starship that was in service with the Vulcan High Command in the mid-22nd century. It was under the command of Captain Tavek.
The Odin was a 24th century Federation freighter.
The Ohniaka III Research Station or Ohniaka III Outpost was a Federation science station without strategic importance on the planet Ohniaka III. The outpost was staffed by 274 Starfleet personnel.

The Omicron Theta Colony, also known as the Omicron Theta Outpost, was a Federation colony located on the planet Omicron Theta in the remote Omicron Theta star system. It was established before 2328 as a completely self-sufficient colony with a primacy focus on the sciences, although there were also farms. Of the 411 colonists who lived at the colony before its destruction, Dr. Noonien Soong remains the best known.
The Onizuka was a Federation Type 15 shuttlepod that was in service to Starfleet in the mid-24th century, attached to the . During its service it was labeled as both shuttlepod 05 and 07.

Orbital 1 was a space capsule launched by the Central Protectorate on Gotana. It was launched on top of a three-stage rocket, and carried two astronauts, the pilot, Gotana-Retz, and the commander, Terrina.
Orbital 6 was an United Earth inspection pod that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-22nd century. It was attached to Shipyard Ops of the Orbital Drydock Facility.
The Orbital Drydock Facility was a Starfleet spacedock where the first warp five starship, , was constructed in the mid-22nd century.
The orbital office complex was a Starfleet space station in orbit of Earth during the late 23rd century.
An orbital probe was a probe utilized by the Romulans to scan a planet from orbit.
Orbital shuttle 5 was a Federation orbital shuttle that was in service with Starfleet from the late 23rd century to the mid-24th century, attached to the Spacedock One.

Around the 2270s, the Salvoxia suffered a cascade failure. System after system failed, and eventually, the generators began to fail one by one. There wasn't enough air to sustain the whole crew, so they began to draw lots, hopefully awaiting rescue, which never came. The entire crew eventually asphyxiated. The Salvoxia drifted in space for eighty years until it was discovered.

It was during the construction a key component overheated and exploded, causing Rutherford to suffer significant injuries, particularly to the left side of his face. The Sarajevo (NC-27) was an United Earth transport that was in service in the mid-22nd century.
The Saratoga was an United Earth starship that was in service with Starfleet in the mid-22nd century.

SATCOM 47 was a communications satellite in Earth orbit in the late 20th century. Owned and operated by Chronowerx Industries, it was augmented with technology which Henry Starling, Chronowerx's CEO, had cannibalized from the 29th century timeship Aeon. Activating the satellite involved an array of bar-like elements spreading open like an umbrella.
SC-4 was the designation of a Starfleet Command shuttlecraft during the early 25th century.

Science Station Tango Sierra was a Federation science station in the Rachelis system, Beta Quadrant. This station was operational by the mid-24th century.
SD-103 (NAR-25820) was a Federation transport that was in service with Starfleet in the late 23rd century, attached to Starfleet Command.

Section 31 Headquarters was a space station used during the mid-23rd century by the covert Starfleet organization Section 31. Listed as an abandoned penal colony, the station was used by Section 31 as a forward operating base and housed the AI known as Control.

The Seeker was a reconnaissance device developed by the Xindi-Reptilians originally for use in the Xindi Civil War. It incorporated anti-gravity technology to fly and seek out enemies and then report back to its operator. Each containing at least one techno-larva, the Seekers, like much other Xindi technology, incorporated biological components – so much so that a Starfleet scanner could actually mistake it for a Xindi bio-sign. Seekers could be prevented from detecting bio-signs using topaline ore.

The Seleya was a Vulcan combat cruiser that was in service with the Vulcan High Command in the mid-22nd century. This ship was under the command of Captain Voris. Its standard crew complement was 147.

It was briefly commandeered by Starfleet Captain Christopher Pike and his senior officers in 2259, after which it and its crew were taken into custody. ()

Sisko's attack ship was a Jem'Hadar attack ship captured by Captain Benjamin Sisko and the crew of Deep Space 9 in the Gamma Quadrant in 2373.

Skylab was a Human space station active in the late 20th century. The station was placed into Earth orbit by the United States of America with NASA overseeing the facility. The solar-powered Skylab could house three astronauts. These astronauts were transported to the facility and were returned to Earth by a command/service module from the Apollo program.
SMT 05 was a 23rd century Federation Class C shuttle assigned to Starbase 5. Used as a medical transport, this vessel, bearing the symbol of Starfleet Medical, had a gray-and-white color scheme.

Sol Station (ID number Sol 398392), also known as Probert Station but most commonly referred to as Spacedock, was a Federation space station located in Earth orbit and operated by Starfleet in the early 25th century. It resembled its predecessor in design, but featured several additional structures. The station was armed with phasers and photon torpedoes. ()

The Sol-398391 was a Federation defense satellite that was in service to Starfleet in the early 25th century. This satellite was located near to the Sol Station. It was destroyed by the Borg-captured Starfleet ships. ()
A solar probe was a type of probe designed to study stars at close distance for scientific research. They could be modified to crash into a sun. The Egg was an example of a solar probe.

Son'a drones were small automated flying devices used by the Son'a, capable of shooting isolinear tags. These probes were capable of pursuing moving humanoids, targeting them and firing dart-like tags onto them.

Spacedock One was a Federation space station operated by Starfleet from the late 23rd to the early 25th centuries. The prototypical example of a "spacedock", it was located in orbit of Earth for most of its service, until it was moved to Athan Prime sometime before 2401.
The Spacematic was a one-man scout ship that was in service in the mid-23rd century. This ship was owned by Cyrano Jones, and was larger than a Class F shuttlecraft.
Sphere 634 was a Borg sphere that was in service in the late 24th century.
Sphere 878 was a Borg sphere that was in service in the late 24th century. This sphere had a complement of eleven thousand drones.
SPT 21 was the registry number of a Federation Class C prison shuttle operated by Starfleet in 2256.
Sputnik 1 was the first artificial satellite launched by Humans. It was built by the Earth's Soviet Union, and its 1957 launch ushered in the Space Age. ( okudagram)
The SS Artemis was a 23rd century Federation colony ship.
The SS Augyn (NGA-24858) was a 24th century Federation commercial transport.

The SS Beagle was a 23rd century Federation class 4 survey vessel operated by the Merchant Service. The Beagle had a crew of forty-seven and was commanded by Captain R.M. Merik; his flight officer was William B. Harrison.
The SS Birdseye was a space module constructed during the late 20th century that was designed to carry deceased, but cryonically preserved, Humans into Earth's orbit.

The SS Botany Bay was a sleeper ship built on Earth in the late 20th century. The Botany Bay was launched from Earth during the Eugenics Wars under the command of Khan Noonien Singh. The Botany Bay was used by a group of genetically-enhanced Humans known as Augments, led by Khan Noonien Singh, in an attempt to escape from Earth after being defeated by non-Augments.
The SS Buckaroo Banzai was a Terran BBI-993-type starship that was in service in the mid-22nd century.
The SS Conestoga was an Earth colony ship that was in service with the Space Agency in the mid-21st century.
The SS Dierdre was a 23rd century Federation freighter. This starship had, at best, a maximum speed of warp 2.

The SS Emmette was an starship in use on Earth and Luna before the of starships.

SS La Sirena (NAR-93131), or simply Sirena, was an unregistered Kaplan F17 Speed Freighter owned and operated by Cristóbal Rios during the late 24th century.
The SS Lakul (NFT-7793) was a transport, under El-Aurian registry, that was in operation during the late-23rd century. It had a crew of twelve.
The SS Manila was a Federation transport ship that was in service in the early 24th century.
The SS Manoa (NAR-28474) was a 24th century Federation transport.

The SS Santa Maria (BDR-529) was a 24th century Federation personnel transport. Santa Maria was sent out to colonize Gemulon V in 2360. En route to her destination, the ship developed problems and crash landed on a planet in the Orellius system for repairs. Once the ship landed, all of its systems failed due to a duonetic field, and the ship's passengers and crew became stranded. Stripped of all technology, the ship was used as living quarters for the colonists, who affectionately renamed it "The Cabin".
The SS Seattle was a Terran NAR18834-type starship that was in service in the early 22nd century.
The SS Shiku Maru (NBT-30894) was a 24th century Federation starship. This vessel was commanded by Captain A. Silvestri.
The SS Tomobiki was a Terran RT-2203-class starship that was in service in the early 22nd century.

The SS Urusei Yatsura was a Terran DY-430 class starship that was in service in the mid-22nd century.

It was considered old and appeared to have been disused long enough for Starfleet to not notice that Locarno had stolen it. In 2381, it was commandeered and reclaimed by Lieutenant jg Beckett Mariner, but a trynar shield prevented her from escaping the Detrion system and thus returning the Passaro to Federation space. Mariner was ultimately forced to detonate a Genesis Device she had seized from Locarno and brought on board to prevent Locarno from reclaiming it, leading to the ship's destruction.
